items.title: 美股七巨頭首度與市場動能背離！資金轉向記憶體、半導體 科技股領導地位生變
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks' Magnificent Seven Diverge from Market Momentum for the First Time; Capital Shifts to Memory Chips and Semiconductors, Changing Tech Leadership
paras: 美股市場長期由大型科技股引領的格局正在出現變化。「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）近期首度與美國股市動能因子呈現反向走勢，顯示這批過去主導市場漲勢的權值股，與高動能股票之間的聯動性正在減弱。
根據《Seeking Alpha》報導，Sherwood News彙整了美股七巨頭ETF(MAGS-US) 與安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子(MTUM-US) 每日價格變動的21個交易日滾動相關係數，發現這項短期衡量指標近期已轉為負值，終結了AI帶動的多頭市場期間，大型科技股長期呈現的高度同步走勢。
美股七巨頭ETF主要追蹤蘋果(AAPL-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 等7大科技企業；安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子則持有近期表現優於大盤的大型股與中型股。
多年來，這兩組股票的漲跌大致同步，因為美股七巨頭一直是市場因子領先地位與指數報酬的重要支柱。
不過，近期市場資金開始轉向記憶體晶片、其他半導體類股，以及標普500指數中更廣泛的成分股，市場輪動也使美股七巨頭不再以過去的「整體性」同步交易。
美股七巨頭ETF與安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子的相關係數轉負，代表科技七雄已不再是市場動能交易的主要驅動力量。當高動能股票持續上漲時，美股七巨頭可能反而落後；而當動能交易降溫時，美股七巨頭則可能相對抗跌。
這項訊號持續時間短，且可能迅速反轉。不過，對於這個過去曾主導市場走勢的股票群體而言，這仍是一次罕見的統計性首次。
其他「科技七雄」相關基金包括：Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF(MAGX-US) 、Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bull 2X ETF(QQQU-US) 及Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bear 1X ETF(QQQD-US) 。
paras_en: The long‑standing pattern of U.S. equities being led by large‑cap tech stocks is changing. The “Magnificent Seven” have recently moved in the opposite direction of the U.S. market momentum factor for the first time, indicating that the once‑dominant heavyweight stocks are losing their linkage with high‑momentum shares.

According to a report on Seeking Alpha, Sherwood News compiled a 21‑day rolling correlation of daily price changes between the Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US) and the MSCI USA Momentum Factor (MTUM‑US). The short‑term metric has turned negative, ending the period of AI‑driven bull market where large‑cap tech stocks moved in tight sync.

The Magnificent Seven ETF tracks the seven major tech companies Apple (AAPL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US). The MSCI USA Momentum Factor holds large‑ and mid‑cap stocks that have recently outperformed the broader market.
For years the price movements of these two groups have been roughly in step, because the Magnificent Seven have been a key pillar of factor leadership and index returns in the market.

However, capital is now flowing into memory‑chip makers, other semiconductor stocks, and a broader set of S&P 500 constituents, causing a rotation that breaks the former “overall” synchronicity of the Magnificent Seven trades.

The correlation turning negative means the seven tech giants are no longer the primary drivers of market‑momentum trading. When high‑momentum stocks keep rising, the Magnificent Seven may lag; when momentum trading cools, they may hold up relative to the market.
This signal is likely short‑lived and could reverse quickly, but for a group that has historically steered market direction, it remains a rare statistical first.

Other funds linked to the “Tech Seven” include the Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGX‑US), the Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bull 2X ETF (QQQU‑US) and the Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bear 1X ETF (QQQD‑US).

items.title: 發債太猛、買家退場！伊爾艾朗：全球公債拋售未完 殖利率仍面臨上行壓力
items.title_en: Bond Issuance Frenzy, Buyers Walk Out! Mohamed El‑Erian: Global Sovereign‑Bond Sell‑off Unfinished, Yields Still Face Upside Pressure
paras: 知名經濟學家伊爾艾朗(Mohamed El-Erian)周五(4日)表示，投資人應預期全球公債拋售潮將持續，原因在於市場正面臨政府、大型雲端服務商及企業大量發債，但可靠買家的承接能力卻日益不足，形成根本性的供需失衡。
伊爾艾朗在義大利切爾諾比奧(Cernobbio)舉行的Ambrosetti論壇期間表示：「我看不到美國有任何立即進行財政整頓的意願。因此，我認為殖利率仍將持續面臨上行壓力。」
全球公債本周遭遇猛烈拋售，因市場日益擔憂通膨及升息，多個主要國家的公債殖利率陡升至數十年高點。債券價格與殖利率呈反向走勢。
伊爾艾朗現任賓州大學華頓商學院Rene M. Kern實務教授，也是安聯(Allianz)首席經濟顧問。
伊爾艾朗表示，目前市場運作本身並沒有出現問題，但美國公債的「可靠買家與長期持有者」正面臨壓力。他說：「基於地緣政治因素，中國已不再像過去那樣願意買進。日本和波灣國家則面臨各自的國內問題。」
伊爾艾朗也提到，挪威主權財富基金正重新檢視手上的美國公債配置。
他表示：「規模雖然不大，但傳統持有者與買家正變得不那麼可靠，這個訊號非常重要。如果看看政府、大型雲端服務商以及企業即將發行的債務規模，遠遠超過市場能仰賴的可靠買家承接能力。」
「這就是利率承受壓力的原因。與其說是通膨、聯準會(Fed)公信力或其他市場提出的因素，不如說更主要是根本性的供需失衡。」

點名英國、日本、法國債務風險較高

伊爾艾朗表示，七大工業國(G7)之中，英國、日本及法國尤其容易受到主權債務問題衝擊。
他說：「無論從數據或其他條件來看，尤其是英國，我稱它為『高Beta國家』。也就是美國利率只要小幅波動，英國的利率波動幅度就會大得多。」
伊爾艾朗也指出，歐洲債市的焦點正在轉移，法國已成為債市關注的核心。
他表示：「過去大家擔心的是義大利。現在義大利的債券殖利率已低於法國，市場焦點轉向歐元區兩大核心國家之一，而不再是歐元區周邊國家。相較於過去，這樣的轉變非常值得關注。」

批美財政部干預債市「走太遠」

伊爾艾朗也批評，川普政府試圖干預市場結果及貨幣政策的做法已經「走得太遠」。
美國財政部上月宣布，在長天期政府借款殖利率飆升至數十年高點後，將至少把長天期美債回購規模擴大一倍。美國副總統范斯(JD Vance)周四則呼籲Fed降息，再度對央行施壓。
伊爾艾朗形容這些行動「令人遺憾」，「這顯示財政部已進入一種思維模式，相信自己不僅可以提供資訊及影響市場結果，甚至可以把市場結果強加於市場。我認為這已經走得太遠。」
他進一步指出：「現在的問題是，要如何從這種做法退回來？我認為結果已經很清楚。這是一個規模龐大的市場，除非你願意承受意料之外的後果與附帶損害，否則不可能長期以人為方式影響它。」
伊爾艾朗表示，今年5月接替鮑爾(Jerome Powell)、由美國總統川普欽點出任Fed主席的華許(Kevin Warsh)，將會「聽到」范斯要求降息的呼聲。
他說：「這讓你感受到，住房負擔能力已變得如此重要的政治議題，因此壓力一定會存在。我認為真正的問題不是『這對Fed意味著什麼』，而是『這對財政部意味著什麼』。因為他希望降息的原因與房貸市場有關。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，目前市場對Fed 9月會議的預期接近五五波，升息與維持利率不變的機率大致相當。

讚華許在傑克森霍爾「做對三件事」

伊爾艾朗表示，就他看來，華許上周在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)央行年會發表演說時，已經「做對了三件事」。
他說：「第一，他回應了外界對其政策反應函數的疑慮。」
「第二，他警告不要過度依賴前瞻指引，以及避免出現『鏡廳效應』(hall of mirrors)。我同意他的看法，前瞻指引已經走得太遠。」
伊爾艾朗認為，華許第三項表態雖然獲得最少關注，卻可能是最重要的一點，「他將人工智慧(AI)描述為潛在的生產要素，這意味著AI可能對供給面產生巨大影響。」
伊爾艾朗說，華許能在半小時內清楚闡述這三項重點，「我認為這是一場做得非常好的演說」。
paras_en: Renowned economist Mohamed El‑Erian said on Friday (the 4th) that investors should expect the global sovereign‑bond sell‑off to continue because markets are facing massive debt issuance by governments, large cloud‑service providers and corporations, while reliable buyers are becoming increasingly scarce, creating a fundamental supply‑demand imbalance.

Speaking at the Ambrosetti Forum in Cernobbio, Italy, El‑Erian said, "I see no willingness in the United States to undertake an immediate fiscal adjustment. Therefore, I think yields will continue to face upward pressure."

Global sovereign bonds suffered a sharp sell‑off this week as markets grew more worried about inflation and rate hikes, with yields on major countries’ bonds soaring to multi‑decade highs. Bond prices move inversely to yields.
El‑Erian is currently a professor of practice at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and the chief economic adviser to Allianz.

He noted that the market itself is not malfunctioning, but the "reliable buyers and long‑term holders" of U.S. Treasuries are under pressure. He added, "Because of geopolitical factors, China is no longer as willing to buy as before. Japan and the Gulf states each face their own domestic issues."
El‑Erian also mentioned that Norway’s sovereign wealth fund is re‑examining its U.S. Treasury holdings.

He said, "Although the scale is not huge, traditional holders and buyers are becoming less reliable, and that signal is very important. If you look at the amount of debt that governments, large cloud providers and corporations are about to issue, it far exceeds the capacity of reliable buyers to absorb it."
"That is why rates are under pressure. It is less about inflation, the Fed’s credibility or other market‑talked factors, and more about a fundamental supply‑demand mismatch."
He singled out higher debt risk in the United Kingdom, Japan and France among the G7 nations.
He said, "By any metric, especially for the UK, I call it a ‘high‑beta’ country. A small move in U.S. rates translates into a much larger swing in British rates."
El‑Erian also noted that the focus in European bond markets is shifting, with France now at the core of attention.

He explained, "Earlier the concern was Italy. Now Italy’s bond yields are lower than France’s, so the market’s focus has moved to one of the two core Euro‑area economies, no longer the peripheral ones. Compared with the past, this shift is very noteworthy."
He criticized the Trump administration’s attempts to intervene in market outcomes and monetary policy as having "gone too far."

The U.S. Treasury announced last month that, after long‑term government borrowing yields surged to multi‑decade peaks, it would at least double the scale of its long‑term Treasury buy‑backs. Vice‑President JD Vance on Thursday urged the Fed to cut rates, again pressing the central bank.

El‑Erian described these actions as "regrettable" and said, "It shows the Treasury has adopted a mindset that it can not only provide information and influence market outcomes, but even impose outcomes on the market. I think that has gone too far."

He added, "The question now is how to retreat from this approach. The result is clear: this is a massive market, and unless you are willing to accept unexpected consequences and collateral damage, you cannot influence it artificially over the long term."
El‑Erian said that in May, Kevin Warsh, who succeeded Jerome Powell and was hand‑picked by President Trump to become Fed chair, will "hear" calls from Vance to cut rates.

He noted, "That makes you feel how housing affordability has become such a political issue, so pressure will inevitably be there. The real question is not ‘what this means for the Fed,’ but ‘what it means for the Treasury,’ because his desire to cut rates stems from the mortgage market."
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market’s odds for a rate hike versus holding steady at the September Fed meeting are roughly 50‑50.
El‑Erian said that, in his view, Warsh last week at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium got "three things right."
He said, "First, he responded to external doubts about his policy reaction function."
"Second, he warned against over‑reliance on forward guidance and cautioned against a ‘hall of mirrors’ effect. I agree with him that forward guidance has gone too far."

El‑Erian believes Warsh’s third point, though receiving the least attention, may be the most important: "He described artificial intelligence as a potential factor of production, implying AI could have a huge impact on the supply side."
He said Warsh was able to clearly articulate these three points in half an hour, "I think it was a very well‑executed speech."

items.title: 輝達砸錢AI客戶恐成泡沫？經濟學家反駁：反而讓AI熱潮更持久
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業持續吸引巨額資金投入，輝達(NVDA-US) 不僅是AI晶片供應商，也逐步成為產業重要的資金提供者，引發擔憂。然而，知名經濟學家Tyler Cowen認為，輝達大舉投入資金支持最終會購買其晶片的AI企業，未必代表市場存在泡沫，反而可能讓這波AI熱潮更具持續性。
根據《Benzinga》報導，Cowen週五（4日）接受「Prof G Markets」Podcast訪問時表示，可以將輝達視為AI產業的某種「最後貸款人」或「最後買家」。
他指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 與Meta(META-US) 也扮演類似角色。
Cowen認為，新技術在發展初期往往需要資金協助才能建立規模，而目前大量資金持續流入AI產業，反而提高這項技術長期成功的可能性。
值得注意的是，Cowen目前是Anthropic經濟顧問委員會成員。輝達去年已承諾，將透過更廣泛的運算合作夥伴關係，對Anthropic投資最高100億美元。

輝達不只賣GPU 也開始協助客戶籌資

外界對AI熱潮的其中一項疑慮，是輝達及其他科技巨頭一方面向AI產業提供資金，另一方面又從這些企業購買晶片與運算基礎設施的需求中受益。
輝達如今已不只是銷售GPU。8月10日，輝達與Apollo、貝萊德(BLK-US) 、黑石(BX-US) 、Brookfield、高盛集團(GS-US) 及KKR (KKR-US) 合作推出融資平台，目標是為AI基礎設施調動超過5000億美元的第三方資金。
一週後，輝達又同意為SB Energy位於俄亥俄州資料中心園區、與OpenAI相關的租賃債務提供最高1050億美元的擔保，同時投資15億美元於SB Energy，且輝達將成為該園區獨家AI運算供應商。
換言之，輝達正運用自身的財務實力及與華爾街的關係，協助客戶取得建造資料中心與運算基礎設施所需的資金，而這些設施最終又將運行於輝達的系統之上。
不過，Cowen認為，這並不代表AI熱潮是由人為資金堆砌而成。他指出，新技術在初期往往需要大量資本才能起步，「新事物會自行建立起來」。

Cowen：AI是不是泡沫不是重點 應問「產品有沒有用？」

談到AI是否形成泡沫時，Cowen直言，這可能是「錯誤的討論」。
他以1920年代的汽車產業為例指出，當時許多汽車製造商最終倒閉，就如同後來許多網路公司消失一樣，但這並不代表背後的技術本身失去價值。
因此，在Cowen看來，投資人真正應該問的是一個更簡單的問題：「這項產品有效嗎？」
對此，他給出的答案相當明確：「是的。」
另一方面，Polymarket交易者也認為AI熱潮短期內崩潰的可能性不高，目前給予AI泡沫在今年破裂的機率為12%。
不過，這並不代表投資人不會蒙受損失。Cowen指出，如果AI熱潮反轉，以債務融資興建的資料中心可能帶來「不利的總體經濟後果」，包括資本損失與償付能力問題。
但他認為，即使AI投資熱潮最終逆轉，其可能造成的衝擊仍遠低於2008年金融危機的程度。

items.title: PIMCO績優基金撤出「科技七巨頭」 轉押亞洲AI設備供應商
items.title_en: PIMCO Top-Performing Fund Pulls Out of "Big Tech Seven" and Shifts to Asian AI Equipment Suppliers
paras: 《彭博》報導，PIMCO旗下績優基金正降低對美國大型科技股的配置，轉向亞洲AI設備供應商、中國金融股及醫療保健類股，尋找下一波投資機會。
PIMCO旗艦基金「平衡收益與成長基金」經理人Emmanuel Sharef表示，美國大型科技公司的估值偏高，加上AI投資支出大幅攀升，不僅推高企業債務負擔，也使獲利前景更加不明朗，因此基金目前低配多數超大型雲端服務商及「科技七巨頭」。
Sharef指出，投資人不必持有市場上最昂貴的股票，也能掌握特定產業趨勢。根據《彭博》彙整資料，這檔基金資產規模接近190億美元，過去3年績效超越97%的同類基金。
該基金採取系統化選股策略，依據價值、品質、動能及成長等指標配置個股。目前仍加碼亞洲市場，主要看好當地企業的獲利成長，以及亞洲公司在AI供應鏈下游環節的布局。只要企業獲利維持強勁，基金預計將延續這項配置方向。
Sharef表示，AI資本支出的擴張規模相當龐大，可望帶動晶片、半導體零組件、散熱設備、纜線互連、光學設備、電源供應器、營建設備及金屬等資料中心相關產品需求。
除亞洲AI供應鏈外，該基金過去約18個月也持續增加生技及生命科學類股部位。
Sharef認為，大型生技公司為分散藥物研發管線而增加併購，已促使部分企業獲利預期獲得上修；隨著AI技術持續發展，未來也可能協助治療更多類型的疾病。
在中國市場方面，金融股是該基金配置比重最大的產業，主要原因是波動相對較低，基金同時也看好原物料類股。受黃金及銅價上漲帶動，MSCI中國原物料指數過去1個月上漲約7.1%，表現超越多數主要產業類股。
Sharef指出，中國的資源開採及原物料企業不僅在資料中心建設中扮演重要角色，也涉及稀土等關鍵資源供應。

paras_en: Bloomberg reports that PIMCO’s top-performing funds are reducing their exposure to large U.S. technology stocks and turning toward Asian AI equipment suppliers, Chinese financial stocks, and healthcare equities in search of the next wave of investment opportunities.

PIMCO’s flagship Balanced Income and Growth Fund manager Emmanuel Sharef said valuations for large U.S. tech companies are too high, and the surge in AI spending is not only raising corporate debt loads but also clouding profit outlooks, so the fund is currently underweight most mega‑cap cloud service providers and the "Big Tech Seven."

Sharef noted that investors don’t need to hold the most expensive stocks in the market to capture sector trends. According to Bloomberg’s compiled data, the fund’s assets are close to $19 billion, and its performance over the past three years has outpaced 97 % of peer funds.

The fund uses a systematic stock‑selection approach, allocating to individual securities based on value, quality, momentum and growth metrics. It continues to increase its Asian exposure, favoring local companies’ earnings growth and their positioning in downstream AI supply‑chain segments. As long as corporate earnings stay strong, the fund expects to maintain this allocation direction.

Sharef said the scale of AI‑related capital spending is massive and is expected to drive demand for chips, semiconductor components, cooling equipment, cabling and interconnects, optical devices, power supplies, construction gear and metals used in data centers.
Beyond the Asian AI supply chain, the fund has been steadily adding biotech and life‑science stocks over roughly the past 18 months.

Sharef believes large biotech firms are expanding M&A to diversify drug pipelines, prompting upward revisions to earnings expectations for some companies; as AI technology advances, it could also help treat a broader range of diseases in the future.

In China, financial stocks make up the fund’s largest sector allocation because of their relatively low volatility, and the fund is also bullish on commodities. Driven by rising gold and copper prices, the MSCI China Materials Index has risen about 7.1 % over the past month, outperforming most major sector indices.
Sharef pointed out that China’s resource‑extraction and materials companies play a key role in data‑center construction and are also involved in supplying critical resources such as rare earths.

items.title: 川普提結束俄烏戰爭方案！美國特使將訪莫斯科、基輔提交
items.title_en: Trump Proposes End to Russia‑Ukraine War; U.S. Envoy to Visit Moscow and Kyiv
paras: 俄烏戰事尋求外交突破之際，美國總統特使威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）與美國總統川普女婿庫許納（Jared Kushner）預計展開俄烏訪問行程。俄羅斯方面消息人士週五（4日）透露，兩人將於9月5日至6日先後前往俄羅斯莫斯科及烏克蘭基輔。
美國總統川普表示，威特科夫與庫許納此行將向俄羅斯提交結束俄烏衝突的方案。
俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）週四（3日）表示，俄烏衝突仍存在解決的可能，但最終能否實現，取決於參與衝突的雙方。

澤倫斯基：談判期間不對俄發動空襲

烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）4日證實，威特科夫與庫許納近日將訪問俄羅斯，並預計於9月6日前往烏克蘭。
澤倫斯基表示，烏方正為兩人的到訪進行準備，並已與負責對美外交工作的團隊召開會議。
他指出，與過去美方外交人員訪問期間的安排相同，烏克蘭將確保俄羅斯領空在相關時段維持正常運行，以保障美方談判人員安全抵達。不過，澤倫斯基強調，烏克蘭關心的是談判人員的安全，而非俄羅斯本身。
澤倫斯基表示，在威特科夫與庫許納訪問及談判期間，烏方不會發動空中打擊；同時，俄羅斯也應採取對等措施，在談判以及處理此次訪問所需後勤安排期間停止空襲。
他說，烏克蘭希望此次訪問及與美方的談判能夠具備建設性與實質內容，並尋找推動戰爭結束的實際方案。烏克蘭也將關注威特科夫與庫許納提出的方案，以及俄羅斯方面的回應。

烏克蘭安局遭俄無人機襲擊 威特科夫訪問行程恐生變

不過，在美方特使準備展開訪問之際，基輔安全情勢再度受到關注，出於安全擔憂，威特科夫似乎正在考慮代替訪問的其他方案。
澤倫斯基4日在社群媒體發文表示，位於基輔市中心的烏克蘭國家安全局（SBU）總部當天遭俄軍無人機襲擊。
澤倫斯基指出，俄軍無人機擊中位於聖索菲亞教堂對面的國家安全局總部大樓，並稱攻擊目標是局長辦公室。烏克蘭國家緊急情況局及執法部門已在現場展開救援與處置工作。
他表示，已與烏克蘭國家安全局局長 Oleksandr Poklad 通話，並指示相關部門準備在適當時機對俄方作出「有力且對等的回應」，烏克蘭軍方將提供支持。
烏克蘭外交部長瑟比加（Andrii Sybiha）同日表示，俄軍襲擊國家安全局總部是重大升級，烏方必須作出堅決回應，並呼籲國際夥伴予以譴責及加大對俄羅斯的壓力。
與此同時，烏克蘭《基輔獨立報》引述匿名消息人士指出，俄羅斯方面並不希望威特科夫與庫許納前往基輔，兩人被告知當地存在安全風險。
目前烏克蘭領空仍處於關閉狀態，威特科夫原本計畫搭乘飛機前往烏克蘭，但在最新安全情勢下，訪問安排可能出現變化。
paras_en: While seeking a diplomatic breakthrough in the Russia‑Ukraine conflict, U.S. President Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff and Trump’s son‑in‑law Jared Kushner are expected to embark on a visit to Russia and Ukraine. Russian sources on Friday (4th) revealed that the two will travel to Moscow and Kyiv on September 5‑6, respectively.
President Trump stated that Witkoff and Kushner’s trip will present Russia with a proposal to end the Russia‑Ukraine conflict.
On Thursday (3rd), Russian President Vladimir Putin said that a solution to the Russia‑Ukraine conflict still exists, but whether it can ultimately be achieved depends on the parties involved.

Zelensky: No airstrikes on Russia during negotiations
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed on the 4th that Witkoff and Kushner will visit Russia soon and are expected to go to Ukraine on September 6.
Zelensky said Ukraine is preparing for the visit and has held a meeting with the team responsible for U.S. diplomatic work.

He noted that, as with past visits by U.S. diplomatic personnel, Ukraine will ensure Russian airspace remains operational during the relevant periods to guarantee the safe arrival of U.S. negotiators. However, Zelensky emphasized that Ukraine’s concern is the safety of the negotiators, not Russia itself.

Zelensky stated that during Witkoff and Kushner’s visit and negotiations, Ukraine will not launch air strikes; at the same time, Russia should take reciprocal measures and halt airstrikes during the negotiations and the logistical arrangements for the visit.

He said Ukraine hopes the visit and negotiations with the U.S. will be constructive and substantive, and will seek practical solutions to end the war. Ukraine will also monitor the proposals put forward by Witkoff and Kushner and Russia’s response.

Ukrainian security agency attacked by Russian drones; Witkoff’s visit may change
However, as the U.S. envoy prepares to travel, Kyiv’s security situation has again drawn attention, and for security concerns, Witkoff appears to be considering alternative arrangements.
On the 4th, Zelensky posted on social media that the Ukrainian Security Service (SBU) headquarters in central Kyiv was hit by a Russian drone that day.

Zelensky noted that the Russian drone struck the SBU headquarters building opposite St. Sophia Cathedral, targeting the director’s office. Ukrainian emergency and law‑enforcement agencies have begun rescue and cleanup operations on site.

He said he had spoken with SBU Director Oleksandr Poklad and instructed relevant departments to prepare a “strong and equal response” to Russia when the time is right, with the Ukrainian military providing support.

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha also said on the same day that the attack on the SBU headquarters was a major escalation, that Ukraine must respond decisively, and called on international partners to condemn the attack and increase pressure on Russia.
At the same time, the Kyiv Independent quoted anonymous sources saying that Russia does not want Witkoff and Kushner to go to Kyiv, and that they were told there were security risks locally.
Ukraine’s airspace remains closed, and Witkoff originally planned to fly to Ukraine, but the latest security situation may change the visit arrangements.

items.title: 美軍18人陣亡、戰費逾375億美元 川普仍稱伊朗戰爭「小菜一碟」
items.title_en: 18 U.S. Service Members Killed, War Cost Over $37.5 Billion; Trump Still Calls the Iran War “A Piece of Cake”
paras: 美國總統川普周五(4日)表示，伊朗衝突對美國而言只是「小菜一碟」，並為副總統范斯(JD Vance)辯護。范斯日前表示，中東持續數月、時斷時續的攻擊不應被稱為「戰爭」。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室被問及范斯前一天的談話時表示，美國目前對伊朗的攻擊是「間歇性」進行，「很多人不把它稱為戰爭」。這場衝突已耗費美國納稅人逾375億美元，並造成18名美軍官兵死亡。
川普說：「我可以理解他的意思。」他接著表示：「我稱它為軍事衝突，因為對我們而言只是小菜一碟，沒什麼大不了的。」
范斯周四在白宮新聞簡報會上拒絕以「戰爭」形容美國與伊朗之間的戰鬥，並避談這場已持續六個月的衝突是否會在11月期中選舉前結束。共和黨正試圖在這次選舉中保住在國會的微弱多數優勢。
當被問到戰爭是否可能在選民於11月3日投票前結束時，范斯的回應是：「我不會稱它為戰爭。現在沒有正在進行的交火。」
不過，就在范斯發表這番說法之際，伊朗周四仍向美國在波斯灣的盟友科威特發動攻擊，以報復美國本周稍早對伊朗發動的一連串空襲。
川普周五與記者交談時還表示，與美國近年參與的其他戰爭相比，美國在伊朗衝突中的死亡人數相對較低。這場戰爭始於2月28日，美國與以色列迄今僅對伊朗發動空襲，尚未向伊朗境內部署地面部隊。
川普說：「我們處理了委內瑞拉，也處理了這件事。在委內瑞拉，我們沒有損失任何人。」這裡指的是美國1月以軍事行動抓補委內瑞拉前總統馬杜洛(Nicolás Maduro)，並將他押送至紐約面臨聯邦毒品販運指控。
川普接著說：「而這次，我們失去了18人。在越南，我們失去了10萬人。在其他衝突中，我們失去了數萬人。」
不過，根據美國國家檔案局紀錄，越戰期間共有58,220名美國武裝部隊成員死亡。
當記者追問，已有18名美軍官兵死亡的情況下，如何仍能將這場衝突形容為「小菜一碟」時，川普重申他的論點——這場戰爭已成功削弱伊朗的核計畫。
川普說：「伊朗不會擁有核武，因為如果他們擁有，你現在可能就不會站在這裡了。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that the conflict with Iran is merely “a piece of cake” for America and defended Vice President JD Vance, who recently said the months‑long, intermittent attacks in the Middle East should not be called a “war.”

When asked about Vance’s remarks in the Oval Office, Trump said the U.S. attack on Iran is being carried out “intermittently” and “many people don’t call it a war.” He noted the conflict has cost U.S. taxpayers more than $37.5 billion and has resulted in 18 American service members being killed.
Trump said, “I can understand his point.” He added, “I call it a military conflict because for us it’s just a piece of cake, nothing big.”

Vance on Thursday at a White House briefing refused to label the fighting between the United States and Iran as a war and dodged questions about whether the six‑month‑old conflict will end before the November midterm election, as Republicans try to preserve their slim congressional majority.
When asked whether the war could end before voters head to the polls on Nov. 3, Vance replied, “I wouldn’t call it a war. There’s no active fighting right now.”
Nevertheless, as Vance made that statement, Iran on Thursday still launched an attack on the U.S. ally Kuwait in the Persian Gulf in retaliation for a series of U.S. airstrikes earlier in the week.

Trump told reporters that, compared with other wars the United States has been involved in recently, the death toll in the Iran conflict is relatively low. The war began on Feb. 28, and the U.S. and Israel have so far only carried out airstrikes against Iran, with no ground troops deployed inside the country.

Trump said, “We dealt with Venezuela, and we dealt with this. In Venezuela we didn’t lose anyone.” He was referring to the January U.S. military operation that captured former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and brought him to New York on federal drug‑trafficking charges.
He continued, “This time we lost 18. In Vietnam we lost 100,000. In other conflicts we lost tens of thousands.”
However, records from the U.S. National Archives show that 58,220 American armed‑force members died during the Vietnam War.

When pressed on how he could still describe the conflict as “a piece of cake” after 18 service members had died, Trump reiterated his argument that the war has successfully weakened Iran’s nuclear program.
Trump said, “Iran will not have a nuclear weapon, because if they had one, you might not be standing here right now.”

items.title: 川普：魏科夫、庫許納將出訪 推動俄烏和平談判
items.title_en: Trump: Witkoff and Kushner to Travel to Promote Russia‑Ukraine Peace Talks
paras: 《路透社》報導，美國總統川普周五(4日)告訴記者，美國特使魏科夫(Steve Witkoff)及其女婿庫許納(Jared Kushner)將出訪，試圖促成俄羅斯與烏克蘭達成和平協議。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室發表談話時暗示，美國已提出一項新的具體方案，目標是結束這場如今已進入第五年的戰爭。不過，他沒有透露方案內容，也沒有說明魏科夫與庫許納將前往烏克蘭、俄羅斯，還是兩國都會前往。
據美國有線電視新聞網(CNN)，一位美國官員當日稍早表示，魏科夫和庫許納計劃未來幾天將造訪莫斯科及烏克蘭首都基輔，試圖推動兩國衝突的外交解決方案。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周五表示，兩人將在訪問莫斯科後，於周日飛往烏克蘭。
川普表示，「我們有一個和平方案。」「我派魏科夫和庫許納前去，他們都是非常優秀的談判代表。他們一直做得非常出色，我們派他們去看看能不能取得一些進展。而且我們很有可能做到。」
川普政府過去試圖結束俄烏戰爭的努力大多沒有取得成果，談判近幾個月也陷入停滯。
8月底，美國中央情報局(CIA)局長John Ratcliffe前往莫斯科，部分目的就是敦促俄方對和平解決方案進行考慮，路透社及其他多家媒體當時曾報導此事。
多數西方情報官員認為，俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)並無意在短期內達成協議。烏克蘭情報部門則認為，普丁近期更可能升級戰事，而不是讓戰爭降溫。
周五，一架俄羅斯無人機擊中烏克蘭安全局(SBU)位於基輔總部。這是戰爭爆發以來遭到攻擊的最高調目標之一。
paras_en: Reuters reported that U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday (the 4th) that U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and his son‑in‑law Jared Kushner will travel in an effort to broker a peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine.

Speaking from the Oval Office, Trump hinted that the United States has put forward a new concrete proposal aimed at ending the war now in its fifth year, but he did not disclose the details of the plan nor specify whether Witkoff and Kushner will go to Ukraine, Russia, or both countries.

According to CNN, a U.S. official said earlier that day that Witkoff and Kushner plan to visit Moscow and Ukraine’s capital Kyiv in the coming days to try to push a diplomatic solution to the conflict.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that the two will fly to Ukraine on Sunday after their visit to Moscow.

Trump said, "We have a peace plan. I sent Witkoff and Kushner, they are both excellent negotiators. They have been doing a great job, and we sent them to see if we can make some progress. And we are very likely to achieve it."
Most of the Trump administration’s attempts to end the Russia‑Ukraine war have yielded little result, and negotiations have stalled in recent months.

At the end of August, CIA Director John Ratcliffe traveled to Moscow, in part to urge the Russian side to consider a peace solution, a trip that Reuters and several other outlets reported at the time.

The majority of Western intelligence officials believe Russian President Vladimir Putin has no intention of reaching an agreement in the short term, while Ukrainian intelligence officials think Putin is more likely to intensify the fighting rather than de‑escalate it.
On Friday, a Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine’s Security Service (SBU) in Kyiv, one of the highest‑profile targets hit since the war began.

items.title: 記憶體股強彈 美光、SanDisk、SK海力士齊飆 AI需求成最大推手
items.title_en: Memory Stocks Rally as Micron, SanDisk, and SK Hynix Surge on AI Demand
paras: 美光科技(MU-US)、SanDisk(SNDK-US)與SK海力士(SKHY-US)周五(4日)分別上漲6.1%、11.9%及8.1%，投資人重新轉向記憶體與資料儲存類股。威騰電子(WDC-US)也大漲約6%。在AI硬體需求強勁，以及主要記憶體產品供應吃緊的帶動下，相關類股經歷數週下跌後迎來反彈。Roundhill Memory ETF今日收盤上漲6.6%。
記憶體類股周五大漲，主要受到以下幾項因素推動：

AI儲存需求強勁： 隨著AI資料中心持續快速擴建，高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與NAND儲存產品仍處於供不應求狀態。據報導，美光最先進的記憶體產線產能已售罄至2026年底，讓主要供應商擁有強大的定價能力。此外，龐大的基礎設施訂單積壓也成為科技巨頭持續採購記憶體的直接證據。例如戴爾科技(DELL-US)目前擁有950億美元的AI伺服器訂單積壓，顯示科技巨頭正積極搶購記憶體廠商能生產的每一片晶圓。
分析師正面評論： 研究機構Lynx Equity發布樂觀報告，預期記憶體市場將持續多年供不應求，並預測整個產業有望迎來突破。該機構給予美光1,325美元、SanDisk 2,450美元的積極目標價。這份正面報告也提振了市場整體情緒。
市場消化總體經濟疑慮： 美國就業報告優於預期，起初引發市場對利率的擔憂。不過，投資人很快消化相關影響，轉而逢低買進先前遭拋售、估值較低的成長股。此外，美國公債殖利率回落，也有助於提振高成長科技股的市場情緒。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US), SanDisk (SNDK-US) and SK Hynix (SKHY-US) each rose on Friday (the 4th) by 6.1%, 11.9% and 8.1% respectively, as investors shifted back into memory and data‑storage stocks. Western Digital (WDC-US) also jumped about 6%. Strong AI‑hardware demand and tight supply of key memory products have sparked a rebound in the sector after weeks of declines. The Roundhill Memory ETF closed up 6.6% today.
Memory‑related stocks surged on Friday, driven primarily by several factors:

Robust AI storage demand: As AI data centers continue to expand rapidly, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and NAND storage products remain in short supply. Reports say Micron’s most advanced memory production line is booked through the end of 2026, giving major suppliers strong pricing power. Massive infrastructure order backlogs also provide direct evidence that tech giants are continuously buying memory chips. For example, Dell Technologies (DELL-US) currently has $95 billion of AI server orders pending, showing that the giants are snapping up every wafer a memory maker can produce. Analyst commentary: Research firm Lynx Equity issued an upbeat report, expecting the memory market to stay supply‑constrained for years and forecasting a breakout for the industry. The firm set aggressive price targets of $1,325 for Micron and $2,450 for SanDisk, boosting overall market sentiment. Market digests broader economic concerns: A stronger‑than‑expected U.S. jobs report initially sparked rate‑hike worries, but investors quickly absorbed the impact and began buying back previously sold‑off, lower‑valued growth stocks. Meanwhile, a pullback in U.S. Treasury yields also helped lift sentiment for high‑growth tech shares.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉盟立大啖先進封裝商機 周漲11%創歷史新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Mingli Seizes Advanced Packaging Opportunities, Rises 11% to Record High
paras: 自動化設備大廠盟立(2464-TW)近期受惠封測大廠積極擴充先進封裝產能，對自動化需求大增，推升盟立目前在手訂單超過150億元，加上在機器人的布局，獲外界肯定，吸引資金進駐，推升本周股價一度衝上224元、改寫歷史新高價，終場收在211元，周漲11.34%。
盟立今年在SEMICON TAIWAN 2026以 「AI in Motion / AI 機器人新動能」 為主軸，大秀整合先進封裝搬運、智動化系統到人形機器人的全方位解決方案。
盟立7月營收8.63億元，月增6.2%，年增62.1%，創下34個月新高，累計前7月營收48.96億元，年增25.6%。受惠半導體自動化需求大爆發，盟立現階段在手訂單上看150億元，預期2026年全年營收有望站回百億元大關，營運可望顯著優於去年。
盟立本周在買盤加持下衝破前高，週五最高達224元，創下歷史新高，但受高檔獲利了結賣壓影響，終場收在211元，單周仍大漲11.34%，三大法人本周全站買方，外資狂掃11,072張，投信與自營商也分別敲進452張、413張。
paras_en: Automation equipment giant Mingli (2464-TW) recently benefited from major packaging test manufacturers actively expanding advanced packaging capacity, leading to a surge in automation demand, pushing Mingli's current order backlog to over NT$15 billion. Combined with its robotics layout, it has gained external recognition, attracting capital inflows, lifting the stock price this week to as high as NT$224, setting a new all‑time high, and closing at NT$211, up 11.34% for the week.

This year Mingli showcased at SEMICON TAIWAN 2026 with the theme “AI in Motion / AI Robotics New Momentum”, presenting a full‑range solution that integrates advanced packaging handling, intelligent automation systems and humanoid robots.

Mingli posted July revenue of NT$8.63 billion, up 6.2% month‑over‑month and 62.1% year‑over‑year, a 34‑month high. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$48.96 billion, up 25.6% YoY. Benefiting from a boom in semiconductor automation demand, Mingli’s current order backlog stands at NT$15 billion, and it expects full‑year 2026 revenue to return to the NT$100 billion level, with operating performance likely to be significantly better than last year.

This week, backed by buying pressure, Mingli broke its previous high, reaching a peak of NT$224 on Friday, a historic high, but was pulled down by profit‑taking selling pressure at higher levels, closing at NT$211. The stock still surged 11.34% for the week. All three major institutional investors were net buyers this week: foreign investors snapped up 11,072 lots, while investment trusts and proprietary traders bought 452 lots and 413 lots respectively.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉松川精密獲AI需求助攻獲利挺 股價創收盤新天價335元
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Matsushita Precision Benefits from AI Demand, Profit Surges, Stock Hits New High of 335 New Taiwan Dollars
paras: 在AI 需求強勁的推升之下，繼電器廠松川精密 (7788-TW) 在涵蓋數據中心變頻器、伺服器電源與 UPS，高電壓大電流產品從 2025 下半年起開始明顯放量，同時，松川在營收高速成長並連創新高，股價本周盤中以347元創新高，4日收盤價335元也改寫收盤新高，主要在於獲利能力的穩步挺升挹注。
松川精密在全球擴產及購併效益顯現，松川精密2026年第二季營收及獲利同創新高，稅後純益2.79億元，季增48.41%，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益3.3元，松川2026年上半年稅後純益4.4億元，年增8.33倍，每股純益5.52元。
松川7月營收首見突破 9 億元達 9.86 億元創新高，月增 19.09%，年增 99.38%，由其公布最新獲利資訊，單月毛利率站穩30%，稅後純益1.22億元，年增1.96倍，單月每股稅後賺進1.53元。2026 年 1-7 月營收 51.03 億元，年增 36.88%，而加計松川上半年財報，1-7月稅後純益5.93億元，累計2026年的1-7月每股純益達7.05元
松川的營收已經連續三季改寫歷史新高，由業績及獲利率推升股價向上，股價本周盤中以347元創新高，4日收盤價335元也改寫收盤新高，技術線型站上所有均線並呈現多頭排列，且由成交量能充足帶動，短線以5日線320元爲支撐。
paras_en: Under the strong push of AI demand, relay manufacturer Matsushita Precision (7788‑TW) has seen its data‑center variable‑frequency drives, server power supplies and UPS, high‑voltage high‑current products start to ramp up significantly from the second half of 2025. At the same time, Matsushita’s revenue has been growing at a rapid pace and reached new highs, with the stock hitting a record intraday high of 347 NT$ this week and closing at 335 NT$ on the 4th, setting a new closing record driven by steady profit improvement.

Matsushita Precision’s global expansion and acquisition benefits are now evident. In Q2 2026, revenue and profit both hit new highs, with net profit after tax of 279 million NT$, a 48.41% quarter‑on‑quarter increase and a turnaround from a loss last year. Earnings per share were 3.30 NT$. For the first half of 2026, net profit after tax reached 440 million NT$, an 8.33‑fold year‑on‑year increase, with earnings per share of 5.52 NT$.

In July, Matsushita’s revenue broke the 900 million NT$ mark, reaching 986 million NT$ for the first time, a 19.09% month‑on‑month increase and a 99.38% year‑on‑year jump. According to the latest earnings announcement, the monthly gross margin stabilized at 30%, net profit after tax was 122 million NT$, a 1.96‑fold year‑on‑year increase, and earnings per share were 1.53 NT$. For January‑July 2026, revenue was 5.103 billion NT$, up 36.88% year‑on‑year, and adding the first‑half report, net profit after tax for January‑July was 593 million NT$, with cumulative earnings per share of 7.05 NT$ for 2026 to date.

Matsushita’s revenue has set a new historical high for three consecutive quarters, pushing the stock price higher through performance and margin improvements. The stock reached an intraday high of 347 NT$ this week and closed at 335 NT$ on the 4th, setting a new closing record. Technical indicators show the price above all moving averages with a bullish alignment, supported by ample trading volume. In the short term, the 5‑day moving average at 320 NT$ serves as support.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉玉山金攻壽險版圖！投信狂掃貨 周漲12%衝破40元創新高
items.title_en: E.SUN Financial Group Expands into Life Insurance! Mutual Funds Rush In, Stock Rises 12% This Week, Breaking NT$40 New High
paras: 玉山金控(2884-TW)於 9/1 正式完成與三商美邦人壽之股權交割程序，合併後總資產規模突破 6.6 兆元，一舉躍升為國內第 5 大上市金控，象徵「金控 2.0」新局正式啟動。受此重大合併題材激勵，再加上升息預期，玉山金本周股價上演慶祝行情，成功突破 40 元大關，周五收盤更衝上 43.55 元歷史新高，單周累計漲幅高達 12.39%，目前總股東人數來到 62.2 萬人。
玉山金本周化身飆股，周四一度飆漲 7%，單周漲幅罕見超過 1 成。籌碼面部分，法人買超態度相當明確，本土投信已連續 22 個交易日大力挺進玉山金，累計敲進達 11.6 萬張；外資也共襄盛舉，呈連續3個交易日買超，累計約 2.4 萬張。儘管金控今、明年須再注資人壽 220 億元，但法人對玉山金併購後市仍具強烈信心。
隨著金融版圖大幅擴充，經營團隊人事亦同步到位。玉山金日前董事會決議，由玉山金控總經理陳茂欽接任人壽董事長，原三商壽副董事長許瀞心則出任總經理，展現跨業整合與經營傳承的決心；相關人事案將依法定程序報請主管機關核准後公告。此外，公司預計於 12 月 1 日將三商壽正式更名為「玉山人壽」。
玉山金控指出，本案為合意併購，經雙方董事會與股東臨時會通過，採股份轉換方式辦理，並已於 2026 年 7 月 7 日取得金管會核准。為充實壽險子公司資本並強化後續業務發展基礎，玉山金控董事會同步通過參與三商壽 160 億元現金增資案。
針對市場關注的顧客與員工權益，玉山金控強調，既有保戶權益將獲得 100% 完整保障，原有的保險契約、保障內容及保單效力皆維持不變。包括業務員、客服專線及全台服務據點均照常運作，服務不中斷；未來更將結合傳統業務員團隊與銀行保險通路優勢，提供更完善的保險產品與服務網絡。玉山金控承諾既有內外勤員工於 3 年內全數留用，並持續推動組織整合與人才培育，提供多元發展機會。
玉山金控表示，壽險將成為金控未來的核心成長引擎之一。邁入金控 2.0 階段，公司將發揮銀行、人壽、證券及投信等跨子公司的整合綜效，建構更具競爭力的金融服務平台，為股東及顧客創造永續價值。
paras_en: E.SUN Financial Holding Co. (2884-TW) officially completed the share transfer with SANSUNG MIBAN Life Insurance on September 1, and the combined total assets now exceed NT$6.6 trillion, propelling it to become the fifth‑largest listed financial holding company in Taiwan and marking the launch of a new “Financial Holding 2.0” era. Driven by the merger news and rising‑rate expectations, E.SUN’s stock surged this week, breaking the NT$40 barrier and closing on Friday at a historic high of NT$43.55, a weekly gain of 12.39%. The total number of shareholders has risen to 622,000.

This week E.SUN turned into a rally stock, spiking as much as 7% on Thursday and posting a rare weekly increase of over 10%. On the institutional side, the buying stance is clear: domestic mutual funds have been net buyers for 22 consecutive trading days, accumulating 116,000 lots, while foreign investors have also been net buyers for three straight days, adding about 24,000 lots. Although the group will need to inject NT$22 billion into the life‑insurance arm in 2024‑2025, institutions remain highly confident about E.SUN’s post‑merger outlook.

With the expanded financial footprint, the management team is also being aligned. The board recently resolved that E.SUN Financial Holding’s General Manager Chen Mao‑qin will become chairman of the life‑insurance subsidiary, while former SANSUNG Life vice‑chairman Hsu Jing‑hsin will take over as general manager, demonstrating a commitment to cross‑industry integration and continuity. The related appointments will be submitted to regulators for approval in accordance with legal procedures. The company also plans to rename SANSUNG Life to “E.SUN Life” on December 1.

E.SUN Financial Holding noted that the transaction is a consensual merger approved by both boards and a special shareholders’ meeting, executed via a share‑exchange and approved by the Financial Supervisory Commission on July 7, 2026. To bolster the capital of the life‑insurance subsidiary and strengthen its future business foundation, the board also approved participation in a NT$16 billion cash capital increase for SANSUNG Life.

Addressing market concerns about customer and employee rights, E.SUN emphasized that existing policyholders will receive 100% protection, with all current contracts, coverage terms and policy validity remaining unchanged. Sales agents, call centers and all service locations across Taiwan will continue operating without interruption. Going forward, the group will combine the traditional agent network with its bancassurance channels to offer a more comprehensive suite of insurance products and services. E.SUN also pledged to retain all existing front‑ and back‑office staff for three years and will continue organizational integration and talent development to provide diverse career opportunities.

E.SUN stated that life insurance will become one of the core growth engines for the financial holding company’s future. Entering the Financial Holding 2.0 phase, the firm will leverage synergies across its banking, life‑insurance, securities and asset‑management subsidiaries to build a more competitive financial services platform that creates sustainable value for shareholders and customers.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉輝達RTX Spark預購告急 微星周漲逾11%外資連六買共2.3萬張
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Nvidia RTX Spark Pre‑order Surge, MSI Gains Over 11% This Week as Foreign Investors Buy 23,000 Lots Over Six Sessions
paras: PC品牌微星(2377-TW)受惠輝達攜手台廠打造的 RTX Spark 高階晶片預購熱潮，本周股價表現亮眼。在新品供不應求與追加晶片訂單的消息激勵下，微星 4 日收 161.5 元，周漲幅 11.38%，周成交量72660張，其中外資連續六個交易日累計買進2.3萬張張，投信也呈現連三買累計敲進 1860 張，自營商亦轉為買超 885 張。
輝達預計今年秋季上市的 RTX Spark 系列電腦成為市場少數亮點，有效為下半年受關鍵零組件漲價壓抑的 PC 市況注入強心針。微星名列全球首波合作品牌，首批搭載高階版 N1x 晶片的筆電開放預購後即接近售罄，主要訂單來自台灣、中國大陸與美國客戶，公司已緊急向輝達爭取更多晶片配額以滿足市場缺口。
微星身為首波搶進的品牌廠，除了既有微軟、聯想、惠普等國際大廠加入生態圈外，宏碁與技嘉等同業也陸續跟進導入相關平台。微星在高階市場率先卡位成功，有助於在整體個人電腦消費需求偏弱的環境下，持續透過高附加價值的創新終端產品維持獲利與營運動能。
paras_en: MSI (2377‑TW), a PC brand, benefited from the pre‑order frenzy for Nvidia’s RTX Spark high‑end chip co‑developed with a Taiwanese manufacturer, delivering a standout performance this week. Boosted by news of supply shortages and additional chip orders, MSI closed at NT$161.5 on the 4th, up 11.38% for the week with a volume of 72,660 lots. Foreign investors bought a cumulative 23,000 lots over six consecutive trading days, while investment trusts purchased a total of 1,860 lots over three days, and proprietary traders turned net buyers with 885 lots.

Nvidia expects its RTX Spark series computers, slated for an autumn launch this year, to be one of the few market highlights, injecting a much‑needed boost into the PC sector that has been dampened by rising component costs in the second half of the year. MSI is among the first global partners; after opening pre‑orders for laptops equipped with the high‑end N1x chip, the initial batch nearly sold out, with major orders coming from Taiwan, mainland China and the United States. The company has urgently sought additional chip allocations from Nvidia to close the market gap.

As one of the earliest adopters, MSI joins other international giants such as Microsoft, Lenovo and HP in the ecosystem, while peers like Acer and Gigabyte are also beginning to integrate the platform. MSI’s early foothold in the high‑end market helps it maintain profitability and operational momentum through high‑value innovative products, even as overall personal‑computer consumer demand remains weak.

items.title: 輝達砸35億美元認購聯發科ECB、SEMICON登場、0050換股名單出爐 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Nvidia Invests $3.5 B in MediaTek ECB, SEMICON Kicks Off, 0050 Stock‑Swap List Released – Weekly Highlights
paras: 聯發科周一(31日)宣布第一次ECB完成定價，其中輝達投資金額達35億美元；SEMICON本周盛大登場，台積電與美超微雙雙揭示新一代水冷散熱藍圖；證交所與富時羅素於周五(4日)公布「臺灣指數系列」及「臺灣高股息指數」2026年第三季度定期審核結果，0050換股名單出爐，以下為本周大事回顧：

輝達砸35億美元認購聯發科ECB 結盟進軍AI工廠、客製化XPU 

聯發科(2454-TW)周一(31日)宣布海外第一次無擔保轉換公司債(ECB)完成訂價，總募資金額達39億美元，折合新台幣超過1,200億元，創下台灣資本市場最高的ECB發行金額，其中，輝達(NVDA-US)投資金額達35億美元，以深化與聯發科的合作夥伴關係。

〈SEMICON〉台積電、AMD齊推新一代水冷板 傳最快明年中量產 

AI晶片功耗持續攀升，散熱已成為關鍵瓶頸。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)與超微(AMD-US)周二(1日)雙雙揭示下一代水冷技術藍圖，同時釋出將封裝與水冷板整合的技術(TIM less)。業界傳出，包括雙鴻(3324-TW)、奇鋐(3017-TW)、健策(3653-TW)及竑騰(7751-TW)等散熱與設備業者均已參與相關技術開發，新一代水冷板方案最快將於明年中進入量產，大搶新一輪AI液冷升級商機。

被動資金準備大搬家！藥華藥晉升臺灣50 世芯-KY轉入中型100 

臺灣證券交易所與富時羅素於周五(4日)正式公布「臺灣指數系列」及「臺灣高股息指數」2026年第三季度定期審核結果。本次最受市場矚目的變動，為生技股藥華藥(6446-TW)因總市值排名躍升至前40名，成功擠進代表台股權值巨頭的「臺灣50指數」成分股，0050 及 006208 皆追蹤該指數；而矽智財(IP)大廠世芯-KY(3661-TW)則遭到刪除，轉入「臺灣中型100指數」。

玉山金完成三商壽交割！躍第5大金控 陳茂欽、許瀞心出任人壽董總 

玉山金控(2884-TW)周二(1日)完成與三商壽之股權交割程序，資產規模逾 6.6 兆元，躍升國內第 5 大上市金控，正式啟動「金控2.0」新局。隨著版圖擴充，高層人事同步發布，由玉山金控總經理陳茂欽接任人壽董事長，原三商壽副董事長許瀞心出任總經理，展現跨業整合與經營傳承的決心。本次併購全面保障保戶權益與全體員工留用，公司預計於12月1日更名為「玉山人壽」，續寫金融新頁。

〈勞動基金績效〉7月大虧2463.7億！新制勞退失血千億 前7月平均分紅10.29萬「縮水」1.3萬 

勞動基金運用局周二(1日)公布最新績效，受全球股市7月劇烈修正、台股單月重挫逾3000點拖累，勞動基金297月單月虧損2463.7億元。今年截至7月底止，整體勞動基金累計收益數降至1兆9560億元，跌破2兆元大關，累計收益率為25.03%，總規模達9兆826億元。相較6月底新制勞退累積收益創下歷史新高，平均每位勞工帳面分紅達 11.6萬元，本次縮水約1.31萬元。

8月台灣製造業PMI連11個月擴張 並創5年來新高 

中華經濟研究院周二(1日)公布8月台灣製造業PMI指數續揚1.0個百分點至62.5%，不僅連續第11個月擴張，也創2021年8月以來新高；未來六個月展望指數則是連8個月維持在60.0%以上。
paras_en: MediaTek announced on Monday (the 31st) that its first unsecured convertible bond (ECB) overseas has been priced, raising a total of $3.9 billion (over NT$1.2 trillion), the largest ECB issuance in Taiwan’s capital markets. Nvidia (NVDA-US) is investing $3.5 billion, deepening its partnership with MediaTek.
Nvidia is pouring $3.5 billion into MediaTek’s ECB, forging an alliance to push into AI factories and custom XPU solutions.

At SEMICON this week, TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) unveiled next‑generation water‑cooling plate technology, with a TIM‑less integration of package and cooling plate. Industry players such as Double‑Hong (3324‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW), Jiances (3653‑TW) and Hongteng (7751‑TW) are already involved in development. The new water‑cooling solution could enter mass production by mid‑next year, sparking a fresh wave of AI liquid‑cooling opportunities.

Passive funds are on the move. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and FTSE Russell released the Q3 2026 periodic review results for the Taiwan Index Series and Taiwan High‑Dividend Index. The most notable change is biotech firm YaoHua Pharma (6446‑TW) climbing into the top‑40 market‑cap ranking and gaining entry to the Taiwan 50 Index, tracked by ETFs 0050 and 006208. Conversely, IP giant SiChin‑KY (3661‑TW) was removed from the Taiwan 50 and shifted to the Taiwan Mid‑Cap 100 Index.

E.Sun Financial (2884‑TW) completed the share‑transfer with SANSUNG Life on Tuesday (the 1st), bringing its assets to over NT$6.6 trillion and propelling it to the fifth‑largest listed financial holding company in Taiwan. The group launched a “Financial Holding 2.0” strategy. E.Sun CEO Chen Mao‑qin will become chairman of the life‑insurance subsidiary, while former SANSUNG Life vice‑chairperson Hsu Jing‑hsin will serve as its general manager. The merger fully protects policyholders and retains staff, and the company plans to rename itself E.Sun Life on Dec 1.

The Labor Fund reported a massive July loss of NT$246.37 billion, driven by a sharp global market correction and a single‑month drop of over 3,000 points in the Taiwan index. As of the end of July, the fund’s cumulative net assets fell to NT$1.956 trillion, slipping below the NT$2 trillion threshold, with a cumulative return of 25.03% on a total scale of NT$9.826 trillion. Under the new pension scheme, average per‑worker accrued dividends peaked at NT$116,000, but this period saw a shrinkage of about NT$13,100 per worker.

Taiwan’s manufacturing PMI rose another point in August to 62.5, marking the 11th consecutive month of expansion and the highest level since August 2021. The six‑month forward outlook index has stayed above 60 for eight straight months.

items.title: 大立光8月營收50.12億元月增2.76%  Q3仍屬市場需求旺季
items.title_en: Largan Precision Reports 50.12 Billion NTD Revenue for August 2026, Up 2.76% MoM, Q3 Still a Strong Demand Season

items.title: 長鑫科技DRAM市占首破10%、躍居全球第4！2028年拚18%挑戰三星、SK海力士
paras: 中國DRAM大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 在全球記憶體市場的市占率持續攀升。市場研究機構Counterpoint Research近日發布最新全球DRAM市場分析指出，2026年第2季全球DRAM市場營收年增385%、季增57%，長鑫科技營收市占率則首度達到10%，排名全球第4。
從主要業者來看，三星電子(005930KS) 仍以38%的營收市占率居冠，SK海力士(000660KS) 以25%排名第2，美光科技(MU-US) 則以24%位居第3。長鑫科技則以10%市占率緊追在後，年增4個百分點、季增2個百分點。
這也是長鑫科技單季DRAM營收市占率首次達到雙位數。2023年時，長鑫科技全球DRAM營收市占率還不到1%，去年第2季則升至4%，今年第1季進一步攀升至8%，第2季再提高至10%。
Counterpoint Research今年8月初原先預估，長鑫科技2026年第2季DRAM營收市占率約為7%。
不過，隨著長鑫科技母公司長鑫科技8月底公布上半年財報，其業績表現明顯超出原先預期，因此Counterpoint在最新報告中將長鑫科技市占率修正至10%。
財報顯示，長鑫科技2026年上半年營收達1503.1億元人民幣，年增873.64%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤為776.05億元人民幣，相較去年同期虧損23.32億元，已扭虧為盈，且上半年業績已超越2025年全年。
根據已公布的第1季業績計算，長鑫科技第2季營收約995.1億元人民幣，年增977.4%、季增約95.9%；歸母淨利潤達528.43億元人民幣，年增由虧轉盈，季增113.4%。
相較之下，三星第2季營收171.5兆韓元，年增130%、季增28%；SK海力士營收79.3187兆韓元，年增257%、季增51%；美光2026會計年度第3季（截至5月28日）營收為414.56億美元，年增346%、季增74%。
這顯示長鑫科技第2季營收的年增與季增幅度，均明顯高於全球前三大DRAM業者。

三大DRAM廠轉向HBM 長鑫科技趁勢擴充常規DRAM

不過，三星、SK海力士與美光的營收增速低於整體DRAM市場，與其產能配置變化有關。三大DRAM業者自去年第4季起，將更多產能轉向毛利率較高、AI加速器所需的高頻寬記憶體（HBM），使常規DRAM產品的產出減少。
美光此前曾表示，生產1份HBM3E需要消耗3份DRAM產能。隨著常規DRAM供應縮減，相關產品價格大幅上漲，最新研究顯示，常規DRAM的利潤率目前已與HBM持平，甚至超越HBM。
在此背景下，主要生產常規DRAM的長鑫科技迅速擴充產能，進一步受惠於市場供應吃緊與價格上漲。
相關報導指出，長鑫科技DRAM產品定價僅比南韓與美國同類產品低5%至10%，並未採取市場新進業者常見的大幅折價策略，代表其營收成長主要反映供應受限環境下的實際銷量增加，而非依靠價格戰搶占市場。

DDR5效能縮小差距 長鑫科技成本劣勢仍超過30%

在產品性能方面，2026年2月Hardware Unboxed進行的遊戲基準測試顯示，長鑫科技消費級DDR5產品的表現已與三星、SK海力士同類產品大致相當。
長鑫科技目前也已量產最新LPDDR6記憶體，首款產品目標速率為12,800 Mbps（12.8 Gbps），符合JEDEC標準，但比SK海力士採用1c製程的LPDDR6產品14.4 Gbps設計上限低約11%。
SK海力士LPDDR6採用第6代10奈米級（1c）製程，並導入EUV微影技術，相較LPDDR5X速度提升33%，功耗效率提升超過20%。
由於艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 的EUV曝光機及部分高階浸沒式DUV設備對中國出口受到限制，長鑫科技目前DRAM產品製造路線仍依賴DUV微影技術，在一定程度上限制技術演進。
目前三星、SK海力士與美光的高階DRAM產品均已推進至第5代10奈米級（1β／1b nm）製程。其中，三星與SK海力士自第4代10奈米級（1α／1a nm）製程便開始導入EUV，美光則自第6代10奈米級（1γ／1-gamma）製程開始導入EUV。
雖然DRAM製造商可以透過DUV多重曝光，達到類似EUV單次曝光的效果，但額外曝光可能增加位置誤差，累積後影響良率，同時也會拉長生產週期並推升製造成本。
根據SemiAnalysis建模以及晨星分析師Wei Jingjie的獨立成本分析，長鑫科技每位元的結構性成本劣勢，相較三星、SK海力士與美光平均水準超過30%。
即使存在成本劣勢，在常規DRAM供應吃緊、價格大幅上漲的環境下，長鑫科技今年上半年主營業務毛利率仍高達84.84%。

15%市占率成關鍵 長鑫科技能否跨過生存門檻？

對長鑫科技而言，10%並非最關鍵的市占率數字，15%才是另一個重要門檻。
Counterpoint Research研究總監Hwang Min-sung指出，長鑫科技必須跨過15%的市場佔有率門檻，才能取得持續投資下一代晶圓廠所需的資金。
這項判斷具有歷史依據。台灣DRAM業者南亞科(2408-TW) 、華亞科與茂德，在2008年全球市場佔有率跌破15%後，逐漸失去競爭生存能力。
Hwang Min-sung表示，當DRAM業者市占率低於15%，將難以為下一代晶圓廠取得融資，市占率可能進一步萎縮至約3%，最終轉為利基型業者。因此，15%被視為長鑫科技必須跨越的重要界線。
然而，若只依賴常規DRAM市場，長鑫科技要達到15%市占率可能面臨挑戰。原因在於，當三星、SK海力士與美光預計在2028年前後完成HBM產能擴充、供需恢復平衡後，部分產能可能重新轉向常規DRAM市場，屆時常規DRAM價格可能下滑，長鑫科技目前的成本劣勢也將成為影響利潤率的重要因素。

長鑫科技拚2028年市占18% 伺服器DRAM成布局重點

從營收結構來看，長鑫科技目前約98%的營收仍來自常規DRAM產品，包括DDR4、DDR5、LPDDR5X，以及最新量產的LPDDR6。HBM目前尚未實現量產銷售，使長鑫科技未來的產品結構與利潤率面臨一定脆弱性。
為降低對消費型DRAM的依賴，長鑫科技正積極擴大伺服器DRAM出貨，其伺服器市場營收占比已從2024年的8.4%提升至2025年的26.5%，持續向更高價值鏈推進。
最新消息顯示，長鑫科技已與字節跳動、騰訊控股(00700-HK) 及百度(09888-HK) 等中國企業簽署長期協議，這些中國雲端基礎設施業者已成為長鑫科技較穩定且價值較高的客戶。
其中，字節跳動於2026年7月與長鑫科技簽署一份價值超過70億美元、為期5年的伺服器DRAM供應協議。阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 則持有長鑫科技約5%股權，同時也是其主要客戶之一。
野村分析師Donnie Teng預估，長鑫科技全球DRAM市占率將在2028年底達到18%，跨過15%的關鍵門檻。投資人Dan Niles則提出更積極的看法，認為中國到2030年可能占全球DRAM市場30%。
相較之下，Counterpoint Research的基準預測較為保守。該機構在長鑫科技IPO時預估，其2028年DRAM位元市占率約為11%，並預計到2035年才達到15%的營收市占率門檻，反映長鑫科技未來可能受到常規DRAM市場環境轉弱及成本劣勢影響，增速將逐步放緩。
長鑫科技今年7月已完成科創板IPO，取得近560億元人民幣融資，資金主要用於擴充產能及下一代技術研發，為後續提升市場競爭力與市占率提供資金支持。

items.title: 美股七巨頭首度與市場動能背離！資金轉向記憶體、半導體 科技股領導地位生變
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks' Magnificent Seven Diverge from Market Momentum for the First Time; Capital Shifts to Memory Chips and Semiconductors, Changing Tech Leadership
paras: 美股市場長期由大型科技股引領的格局正在出現變化。「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）近期首度與美國股市動能因子呈現反向走勢，顯示這批過去主導市場漲勢的權值股，與高動能股票之間的聯動性正在減弱。
根據《Seeking Alpha》報導，Sherwood News彙整了美股七巨頭ETF(MAGS-US) 與安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子(MTUM-US) 每日價格變動的21個交易日滾動相關係數，發現這項短期衡量指標近期已轉為負值，終結了AI帶動的多頭市場期間，大型科技股長期呈現的高度同步走勢。
美股七巨頭ETF主要追蹤蘋果(AAPL-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 等7大科技企業；安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子則持有近期表現優於大盤的大型股與中型股。
多年來，這兩組股票的漲跌大致同步，因為美股七巨頭一直是市場因子領先地位與指數報酬的重要支柱。
不過，近期市場資金開始轉向記憶體晶片、其他半導體類股，以及標普500指數中更廣泛的成分股，市場輪動也使美股七巨頭不再以過去的「整體性」同步交易。
美股七巨頭ETF與安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子的相關係數轉負，代表科技七雄已不再是市場動能交易的主要驅動力量。當高動能股票持續上漲時，美股七巨頭可能反而落後；而當動能交易降溫時，美股七巨頭則可能相對抗跌。
這項訊號持續時間短，且可能迅速反轉。不過，對於這個過去曾主導市場走勢的股票群體而言，這仍是一次罕見的統計性首次。
其他「科技七雄」相關基金包括：Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF(MAGX-US) 、Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bull 2X ETF(QQQU-US) 及Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bear 1X ETF(QQQD-US) 。
paras_en: The long‑standing pattern of U.S. equities being led by large‑cap tech stocks is changing. The “Magnificent Seven” have recently moved in the opposite direction of the U.S. market momentum factor for the first time, indicating that the once‑dominant heavyweight stocks are losing their linkage with high‑momentum shares.

According to a report on Seeking Alpha, Sherwood News compiled a 21‑day rolling correlation of daily price changes between the Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US) and the MSCI USA Momentum Factor (MTUM‑US). The short‑term metric has turned negative, ending the period of AI‑driven bull market where large‑cap tech stocks moved in tight sync.

The Magnificent Seven ETF tracks the seven major tech companies Apple (AAPL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US). The MSCI USA Momentum Factor holds large‑ and mid‑cap stocks that have recently outperformed the broader market.
For years the price movements of these two groups have been roughly in step, because the Magnificent Seven have been a key pillar of factor leadership and index returns in the market.

However, capital is now flowing into memory‑chip makers, other semiconductor stocks, and a broader set of S&P 500 constituents, causing a rotation that breaks the former “overall” synchronicity of the Magnificent Seven trades.

The correlation turning negative means the seven tech giants are no longer the primary drivers of market‑momentum trading. When high‑momentum stocks keep rising, the Magnificent Seven may lag; when momentum trading cools, they may hold up relative to the market.
This signal is likely short‑lived and could reverse quickly, but for a group that has historically steered market direction, it remains a rare statistical first.

Other funds linked to the “Tech Seven” include the Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGX‑US), the Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bull 2X ETF (QQQU‑US) and the Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bear 1X ETF (QQQD‑US).

items.title: 發債太猛、買家退場！伊爾艾朗：全球公債拋售未完 殖利率仍面臨上行壓力
items.title_en: Bond Issuance Frenzy, Buyers Walk Out! Mohamed El‑Erian: Global Sovereign‑Bond Sell‑off Unfinished, Yields Still Face Upside Pressure
paras: 知名經濟學家伊爾艾朗(Mohamed El-Erian)周五(4日)表示，投資人應預期全球公債拋售潮將持續，原因在於市場正面臨政府、大型雲端服務商及企業大量發債，但可靠買家的承接能力卻日益不足，形成根本性的供需失衡。
伊爾艾朗在義大利切爾諾比奧(Cernobbio)舉行的Ambrosetti論壇期間表示：「我看不到美國有任何立即進行財政整頓的意願。因此，我認為殖利率仍將持續面臨上行壓力。」
全球公債本周遭遇猛烈拋售，因市場日益擔憂通膨及升息，多個主要國家的公債殖利率陡升至數十年高點。債券價格與殖利率呈反向走勢。
伊爾艾朗現任賓州大學華頓商學院Rene M. Kern實務教授，也是安聯(Allianz)首席經濟顧問。
伊爾艾朗表示，目前市場運作本身並沒有出現問題，但美國公債的「可靠買家與長期持有者」正面臨壓力。他說：「基於地緣政治因素，中國已不再像過去那樣願意買進。日本和波灣國家則面臨各自的國內問題。」
伊爾艾朗也提到，挪威主權財富基金正重新檢視手上的美國公債配置。
他表示：「規模雖然不大，但傳統持有者與買家正變得不那麼可靠，這個訊號非常重要。如果看看政府、大型雲端服務商以及企業即將發行的債務規模，遠遠超過市場能仰賴的可靠買家承接能力。」
「這就是利率承受壓力的原因。與其說是通膨、聯準會(Fed)公信力或其他市場提出的因素，不如說更主要是根本性的供需失衡。」

點名英國、日本、法國債務風險較高

伊爾艾朗表示，七大工業國(G7)之中，英國、日本及法國尤其容易受到主權債務問題衝擊。
他說：「無論從數據或其他條件來看，尤其是英國，我稱它為『高Beta國家』。也就是美國利率只要小幅波動，英國的利率波動幅度就會大得多。」
伊爾艾朗也指出，歐洲債市的焦點正在轉移，法國已成為債市關注的核心。
他表示：「過去大家擔心的是義大利。現在義大利的債券殖利率已低於法國，市場焦點轉向歐元區兩大核心國家之一，而不再是歐元區周邊國家。相較於過去，這樣的轉變非常值得關注。」

批美財政部干預債市「走太遠」

伊爾艾朗也批評，川普政府試圖干預市場結果及貨幣政策的做法已經「走得太遠」。
美國財政部上月宣布，在長天期政府借款殖利率飆升至數十年高點後，將至少把長天期美債回購規模擴大一倍。美國副總統范斯(JD Vance)周四則呼籲Fed降息，再度對央行施壓。
伊爾艾朗形容這些行動「令人遺憾」，「這顯示財政部已進入一種思維模式，相信自己不僅可以提供資訊及影響市場結果，甚至可以把市場結果強加於市場。我認為這已經走得太遠。」
他進一步指出：「現在的問題是，要如何從這種做法退回來？我認為結果已經很清楚。這是一個規模龐大的市場，除非你願意承受意料之外的後果與附帶損害，否則不可能長期以人為方式影響它。」
伊爾艾朗表示，今年5月接替鮑爾(Jerome Powell)、由美國總統川普欽點出任Fed主席的華許(Kevin Warsh)，將會「聽到」范斯要求降息的呼聲。
他說：「這讓你感受到，住房負擔能力已變得如此重要的政治議題，因此壓力一定會存在。我認為真正的問題不是『這對Fed意味著什麼』，而是『這對財政部意味著什麼』。因為他希望降息的原因與房貸市場有關。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，目前市場對Fed 9月會議的預期接近五五波，升息與維持利率不變的機率大致相當。

讚華許在傑克森霍爾「做對三件事」

伊爾艾朗表示，就他看來，華許上周在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)央行年會發表演說時，已經「做對了三件事」。
他說：「第一，他回應了外界對其政策反應函數的疑慮。」
「第二，他警告不要過度依賴前瞻指引，以及避免出現『鏡廳效應』(hall of mirrors)。我同意他的看法，前瞻指引已經走得太遠。」
伊爾艾朗認為，華許第三項表態雖然獲得最少關注，卻可能是最重要的一點，「他將人工智慧(AI)描述為潛在的生產要素，這意味著AI可能對供給面產生巨大影響。」
伊爾艾朗說，華許能在半小時內清楚闡述這三項重點，「我認為這是一場做得非常好的演說」。
paras_en: Renowned economist Mohamed El‑Erian said on Friday (the 4th) that investors should expect the global sovereign‑bond sell‑off to continue because markets are facing massive debt issuance by governments, large cloud‑service providers and corporations, while reliable buyers are becoming increasingly scarce, creating a fundamental supply‑demand imbalance.

Speaking at the Ambrosetti Forum in Cernobbio, Italy, El‑Erian said, "I see no willingness in the United States to undertake an immediate fiscal adjustment. Therefore, I think yields will continue to face upward pressure."

Global sovereign bonds suffered a sharp sell‑off this week as markets grew more worried about inflation and rate hikes, with yields on major countries’ bonds soaring to multi‑decade highs. Bond prices move inversely to yields.
El‑Erian is currently a professor of practice at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and the chief economic adviser to Allianz.

He noted that the market itself is not malfunctioning, but the "reliable buyers and long‑term holders" of U.S. Treasuries are under pressure. He added, "Because of geopolitical factors, China is no longer as willing to buy as before. Japan and the Gulf states each face their own domestic issues."
El‑Erian also mentioned that Norway’s sovereign wealth fund is re‑examining its U.S. Treasury holdings.

He said, "Although the scale is not huge, traditional holders and buyers are becoming less reliable, and that signal is very important. If you look at the amount of debt that governments, large cloud providers and corporations are about to issue, it far exceeds the capacity of reliable buyers to absorb it."
"That is why rates are under pressure. It is less about inflation, the Fed’s credibility or other market‑talked factors, and more about a fundamental supply‑demand mismatch."
He singled out higher debt risk in the United Kingdom, Japan and France among the G7 nations.
He said, "By any metric, especially for the UK, I call it a ‘high‑beta’ country. A small move in U.S. rates translates into a much larger swing in British rates."
El‑Erian also noted that the focus in European bond markets is shifting, with France now at the core of attention.

He explained, "Earlier the concern was Italy. Now Italy’s bond yields are lower than France’s, so the market’s focus has moved to one of the two core Euro‑area economies, no longer the peripheral ones. Compared with the past, this shift is very noteworthy."
He criticized the Trump administration’s attempts to intervene in market outcomes and monetary policy as having "gone too far."

The U.S. Treasury announced last month that, after long‑term government borrowing yields surged to multi‑decade peaks, it would at least double the scale of its long‑term Treasury buy‑backs. Vice‑President JD Vance on Thursday urged the Fed to cut rates, again pressing the central bank.

El‑Erian described these actions as "regrettable" and said, "It shows the Treasury has adopted a mindset that it can not only provide information and influence market outcomes, but even impose outcomes on the market. I think that has gone too far."

He added, "The question now is how to retreat from this approach. The result is clear: this is a massive market, and unless you are willing to accept unexpected consequences and collateral damage, you cannot influence it artificially over the long term."
El‑Erian said that in May, Kevin Warsh, who succeeded Jerome Powell and was hand‑picked by President Trump to become Fed chair, will "hear" calls from Vance to cut rates.

He noted, "That makes you feel how housing affordability has become such a political issue, so pressure will inevitably be there. The real question is not ‘what this means for the Fed,’ but ‘what it means for the Treasury,’ because his desire to cut rates stems from the mortgage market."
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market’s odds for a rate hike versus holding steady at the September Fed meeting are roughly 50‑50.
El‑Erian said that, in his view, Warsh last week at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium got "three things right."
He said, "First, he responded to external doubts about his policy reaction function."
"Second, he warned against over‑reliance on forward guidance and cautioned against a ‘hall of mirrors’ effect. I agree with him that forward guidance has gone too far."

El‑Erian believes Warsh’s third point, though receiving the least attention, may be the most important: "He described artificial intelligence as a potential factor of production, implying AI could have a huge impact on the supply side."
He said Warsh was able to clearly articulate these three points in half an hour, "I think it was a very well‑executed speech."

items.title: 輝達砸錢AI客戶恐成泡沫？經濟學家反駁：反而讓AI熱潮更持久
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業持續吸引巨額資金投入，輝達(NVDA-US) 不僅是AI晶片供應商，也逐步成為產業重要的資金提供者，引發擔憂。然而，知名經濟學家Tyler Cowen認為，輝達大舉投入資金支持最終會購買其晶片的AI企業，未必代表市場存在泡沫，反而可能讓這波AI熱潮更具持續性。
根據《Benzinga》報導，Cowen週五（4日）接受「Prof G Markets」Podcast訪問時表示，可以將輝達視為AI產業的某種「最後貸款人」或「最後買家」。
他指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 與Meta(META-US) 也扮演類似角色。
Cowen認為，新技術在發展初期往往需要資金協助才能建立規模，而目前大量資金持續流入AI產業，反而提高這項技術長期成功的可能性。
值得注意的是，Cowen目前是Anthropic經濟顧問委員會成員。輝達去年已承諾，將透過更廣泛的運算合作夥伴關係，對Anthropic投資最高100億美元。

輝達不只賣GPU 也開始協助客戶籌資

外界對AI熱潮的其中一項疑慮，是輝達及其他科技巨頭一方面向AI產業提供資金，另一方面又從這些企業購買晶片與運算基礎設施的需求中受益。
輝達如今已不只是銷售GPU。8月10日，輝達與Apollo、貝萊德(BLK-US) 、黑石(BX-US) 、Brookfield、高盛集團(GS-US) 及KKR (KKR-US) 合作推出融資平台，目標是為AI基礎設施調動超過5000億美元的第三方資金。
一週後，輝達又同意為SB Energy位於俄亥俄州資料中心園區、與OpenAI相關的租賃債務提供最高1050億美元的擔保，同時投資15億美元於SB Energy，且輝達將成為該園區獨家AI運算供應商。
換言之，輝達正運用自身的財務實力及與華爾街的關係，協助客戶取得建造資料中心與運算基礎設施所需的資金，而這些設施最終又將運行於輝達的系統之上。
不過，Cowen認為，這並不代表AI熱潮是由人為資金堆砌而成。他指出，新技術在初期往往需要大量資本才能起步，「新事物會自行建立起來」。

Cowen：AI是不是泡沫不是重點 應問「產品有沒有用？」

談到AI是否形成泡沫時，Cowen直言，這可能是「錯誤的討論」。
他以1920年代的汽車產業為例指出，當時許多汽車製造商最終倒閉，就如同後來許多網路公司消失一樣，但這並不代表背後的技術本身失去價值。
因此，在Cowen看來，投資人真正應該問的是一個更簡單的問題：「這項產品有效嗎？」
對此，他給出的答案相當明確：「是的。」
另一方面，Polymarket交易者也認為AI熱潮短期內崩潰的可能性不高，目前給予AI泡沫在今年破裂的機率為12%。
不過，這並不代表投資人不會蒙受損失。Cowen指出，如果AI熱潮反轉，以債務融資興建的資料中心可能帶來「不利的總體經濟後果」，包括資本損失與償付能力問題。
但他認為，即使AI投資熱潮最終逆轉，其可能造成的衝擊仍遠低於2008年金融危機的程度。

items.title: PIMCO績優基金撤出「科技七巨頭」 轉押亞洲AI設備供應商
items.title_en: PIMCO Top-Performing Fund Pulls Out of "Big Tech Seven" and Shifts to Asian AI Equipment Suppliers
paras: 《彭博》報導，PIMCO旗下績優基金正降低對美國大型科技股的配置，轉向亞洲AI設備供應商、中國金融股及醫療保健類股，尋找下一波投資機會。
PIMCO旗艦基金「平衡收益與成長基金」經理人Emmanuel Sharef表示，美國大型科技公司的估值偏高，加上AI投資支出大幅攀升，不僅推高企業債務負擔，也使獲利前景更加不明朗，因此基金目前低配多數超大型雲端服務商及「科技七巨頭」。
Sharef指出，投資人不必持有市場上最昂貴的股票，也能掌握特定產業趨勢。根據《彭博》彙整資料，這檔基金資產規模接近190億美元，過去3年績效超越97%的同類基金。
該基金採取系統化選股策略，依據價值、品質、動能及成長等指標配置個股。目前仍加碼亞洲市場，主要看好當地企業的獲利成長，以及亞洲公司在AI供應鏈下游環節的布局。只要企業獲利維持強勁，基金預計將延續這項配置方向。
Sharef表示，AI資本支出的擴張規模相當龐大，可望帶動晶片、半導體零組件、散熱設備、纜線互連、光學設備、電源供應器、營建設備及金屬等資料中心相關產品需求。
除亞洲AI供應鏈外，該基金過去約18個月也持續增加生技及生命科學類股部位。
Sharef認為，大型生技公司為分散藥物研發管線而增加併購，已促使部分企業獲利預期獲得上修；隨著AI技術持續發展，未來也可能協助治療更多類型的疾病。
在中國市場方面，金融股是該基金配置比重最大的產業，主要原因是波動相對較低，基金同時也看好原物料類股。受黃金及銅價上漲帶動，MSCI中國原物料指數過去1個月上漲約7.1%，表現超越多數主要產業類股。
Sharef指出，中國的資源開採及原物料企業不僅在資料中心建設中扮演重要角色，也涉及稀土等關鍵資源供應。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reports that PIMCO’s top-performing funds are reducing their exposure to large U.S. technology stocks and turning toward Asian AI equipment suppliers, Chinese financial stocks, and healthcare equities in search of the next wave of investment opportunities.

PIMCO’s flagship Balanced Income and Growth Fund manager Emmanuel Sharef said valuations for large U.S. tech companies are too high, and the surge in AI spending is not only raising corporate debt loads but also clouding profit outlooks, so the fund is currently underweight most mega‑cap cloud service providers and the "Big Tech Seven."

Sharef noted that investors don’t need to hold the most expensive stocks in the market to capture sector trends. According to Bloomberg’s compiled data, the fund’s assets are close to $19 billion, and its performance over the past three years has outpaced 97 % of peer funds.

The fund uses a systematic stock‑selection approach, allocating to individual securities based on value, quality, momentum and growth metrics. It continues to increase its Asian exposure, favoring local companies’ earnings growth and their positioning in downstream AI supply‑chain segments. As long as corporate earnings stay strong, the fund expects to maintain this allocation direction.

Sharef said the scale of AI‑related capital spending is massive and is expected to drive demand for chips, semiconductor components, cooling equipment, cabling and interconnects, optical devices, power supplies, construction gear and metals used in data centers.
Beyond the Asian AI supply chain, the fund has been steadily adding biotech and life‑science stocks over roughly the past 18 months.

Sharef believes large biotech firms are expanding M&A to diversify drug pipelines, prompting upward revisions to earnings expectations for some companies; as AI technology advances, it could also help treat a broader range of diseases in the future.

In China, financial stocks make up the fund’s largest sector allocation because of their relatively low volatility, and the fund is also bullish on commodities. Driven by rising gold and copper prices, the MSCI China Materials Index has risen about 7.1 % over the past month, outperforming most major sector indices.
Sharef pointed out that China’s resource‑extraction and materials companies play a key role in data‑center construction and are also involved in supplying critical resources such as rare earths.
