items.title: 川普：魏科夫、庫許納將出訪 推動俄烏和平談判
items.title_en: Trump: Witkoff and Kushner to Travel to Promote Russia‑Ukraine Peace Talks
paras: 《路透社》報導，美國總統川普周五(4日)告訴記者，美國特使魏科夫(Steve Witkoff)及其女婿庫許納(Jared Kushner)將出訪，試圖促成俄羅斯與烏克蘭達成和平協議。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室發表談話時暗示，美國已提出一項新的具體方案，目標是結束這場如今已進入第五年的戰爭。不過，他沒有透露方案內容，也沒有說明魏科夫與庫許納將前往烏克蘭、俄羅斯，還是兩國都會前往。
據美國有線電視新聞網(CNN)，一位美國官員當日稍早表示，魏科夫和庫許納計劃未來幾天將造訪莫斯科及烏克蘭首都基輔，試圖推動兩國衝突的外交解決方案。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周五表示，兩人將在訪問莫斯科後，於周日飛往烏克蘭。
川普表示，「我們有一個和平方案。」「我派魏科夫和庫許納前去，他們都是非常優秀的談判代表。他們一直做得非常出色，我們派他們去看看能不能取得一些進展。而且我們很有可能做到。」
川普政府過去試圖結束俄烏戰爭的努力大多沒有取得成果，談判近幾個月也陷入停滯。
8月底，美國中央情報局(CIA)局長John Ratcliffe前往莫斯科，部分目的就是敦促俄方對和平解決方案進行考慮，路透社及其他多家媒體當時曾報導此事。
多數西方情報官員認為，俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)並無意在短期內達成協議。烏克蘭情報部門則認為，普丁近期更可能升級戰事，而不是讓戰爭降溫。
周五，一架俄羅斯無人機擊中烏克蘭安全局(SBU)位於基輔總部。這是戰爭爆發以來遭到攻擊的最高調目標之一。
paras_en: Reuters reported that U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday (the 4th) that U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and his son‑in‑law Jared Kushner will travel in an effort to broker a peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine.

Speaking from the Oval Office, Trump hinted that the United States has put forward a new concrete proposal aimed at ending the war now in its fifth year, but he did not disclose the details of the plan nor specify whether Witkoff and Kushner will go to Ukraine, Russia, or both countries.

According to CNN, a U.S. official said earlier that day that Witkoff and Kushner plan to visit Moscow and Ukraine’s capital Kyiv in the coming days to try to push a diplomatic solution to the conflict.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that the two will fly to Ukraine on Sunday after their visit to Moscow.

Trump said, "We have a peace plan. I sent Witkoff and Kushner, they are both excellent negotiators. They have been doing a great job, and we sent them to see if we can make some progress. And we are very likely to achieve it."
Most of the Trump administration’s attempts to end the Russia‑Ukraine war have yielded little result, and negotiations have stalled in recent months.

At the end of August, CIA Director John Ratcliffe traveled to Moscow, in part to urge the Russian side to consider a peace solution, a trip that Reuters and several other outlets reported at the time.

The majority of Western intelligence officials believe Russian President Vladimir Putin has no intention of reaching an agreement in the short term, while Ukrainian intelligence officials think Putin is more likely to intensify the fighting rather than de‑escalate it.
On Friday, a Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine’s Security Service (SBU) in Kyiv, one of the highest‑profile targets hit since the war began.

items.title: 記憶體股強彈 美光、SanDisk、SK海力士齊飆 AI需求成最大推手
items.title_en: Memory Stocks Rally as Micron, SanDisk, and SK Hynix Surge on AI Demand
paras: 美光科技(MU-US)、SanDisk(SNDK-US)與SK海力士(SKHY-US)周五(4日)分別上漲6.1%、11.9%及8.1%，投資人重新轉向記憶體與資料儲存類股。威騰電子(WDC-US)也大漲約6%。在AI硬體需求強勁，以及主要記憶體產品供應吃緊的帶動下，相關類股經歷數週下跌後迎來反彈。Roundhill Memory ETF今日收盤上漲6.6%。
記憶體類股周五大漲，主要受到以下幾項因素推動：

AI儲存需求強勁： 隨著AI資料中心持續快速擴建，高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與NAND儲存產品仍處於供不應求狀態。據報導，美光最先進的記憶體產線產能已售罄至2026年底，讓主要供應商擁有強大的定價能力。此外，龐大的基礎設施訂單積壓也成為科技巨頭持續採購記憶體的直接證據。例如戴爾科技(DELL-US)目前擁有950億美元的AI伺服器訂單積壓，顯示科技巨頭正積極搶購記憶體廠商能生產的每一片晶圓。
分析師正面評論： 研究機構Lynx Equity發布樂觀報告，預期記憶體市場將持續多年供不應求，並預測整個產業有望迎來突破。該機構給予美光1,325美元、SanDisk 2,450美元的積極目標價。這份正面報告也提振了市場整體情緒。
市場消化總體經濟疑慮： 美國就業報告優於預期，起初引發市場對利率的擔憂。不過，投資人很快消化相關影響，轉而逢低買進先前遭拋售、估值較低的成長股。此外，美國公債殖利率回落，也有助於提振高成長科技股的市場情緒。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US), SanDisk (SNDK-US) and SK Hynix (SKHY-US) each rose on Friday (the 4th) by 6.1%, 11.9% and 8.1% respectively, as investors shifted back into memory and data‑storage stocks. Western Digital (WDC-US) also jumped about 6%. Strong AI‑hardware demand and tight supply of key memory products have sparked a rebound in the sector after weeks of declines. The Roundhill Memory ETF closed up 6.6% today.
Memory‑related stocks surged on Friday, driven primarily by several factors:

Robust AI storage demand: As AI data centers continue to expand rapidly, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and NAND storage products remain in short supply. Reports say Micron’s most advanced memory production line is booked through the end of 2026, giving major suppliers strong pricing power. Massive infrastructure order backlogs also provide direct evidence that tech giants are continuously buying memory chips. For example, Dell Technologies (DELL-US) currently has $95 billion of AI server orders pending, showing that the giants are snapping up every wafer a memory maker can produce. Analyst commentary: Research firm Lynx Equity issued an upbeat report, expecting the memory market to stay supply‑constrained for years and forecasting a breakout for the industry. The firm set aggressive price targets of $1,325 for Micron and $2,450 for SanDisk, boosting overall market sentiment. Market digests broader economic concerns: A stronger‑than‑expected U.S. jobs report initially sparked rate‑hike worries, but investors quickly absorbed the impact and began buying back previously sold‑off, lower‑valued growth stocks. Meanwhile, a pullback in U.S. Treasury yields also helped lift sentiment for high‑growth tech shares.

items.title: 三星攜手Arm攻端側AI！2奈米客製晶片啟動 OpenAI傳成潛在客戶
items.title_en: Samsung Teams Up with Arm on Edge AI! 2nm Custom Chip Launches, OpenAI Rumored as Potential Customer
paras: 三星電子(005930-KS)正與晶片架構設計商Arm深化合作, 共同開發下一代端側人工智慧(AI)系統單晶片(SoC), 並計畫採用三星2奈米製程量產。據韓國媒體報導, Arm已於8月底批准這項專案的初期非重複性工程費用(NRE), 雙方隨後正式啟動共同開發, 代表這項端側AI晶片計畫已進入實質推進階段。
根據業界消息, 此次合作由Arm提供AI加速器(AIC)架構、RTL等核心設計技術, 並將最終客戶需求傳達給三星, 同時負責協調及掌握整體開發進度。三星電子系統LSI事業部則負責SoC具體設計, 晶圓代工事業部則預計採用2奈米先進製程負責後續量產。
值得注意的是, 業界人士推測, 這款客製化晶片的最終客戶候選人可能包括OpenAI。不過, 目前三星、Arm及OpenAI均未正式確認OpenAI就是這項專案的最終客戶, 因此相關消息仍應視為市場及業界推測。
此次合作採用有限使用授權(LUL, Limited Use License)模式。換言之, Arm提供的架構及相關技術並非供三星自由使用於所有產品, 而是限定在特定客戶及特定產品的開發範圍內。Arm在專案中主要扮演核心技術提供者及共同開發夥伴, 並非直接向市場銷售這款晶片。
在商業模式上, 三星將承擔從SoC設計到製造的主要工作, 完成晶片後再直接交付最終客戶並實現商業收入。這使三星有機會同時從系統LSI設計及晶圓代工兩大業務獲得收益, 與單純承接晶圓代工訂單相比, 更能發揮其設計與製造垂直整合的優勢。
這項合作的核心背景, 是AI運算正從雲端資料中心逐步向智慧型手機、PC及其他終端裝置延伸。傳統AI服務大量依賴雲端伺服器進行推理及資料處理, 端側AI則可直接在裝置本身完成部分運算, 有助降低對雲端算力的依賴, 同時改善反應速度、功耗及資料隱私。
隨著生成式AI功能開始進入更多消費電子產品, 不同裝置對AI運算能力、功耗、延遲及成本的要求也出現差異。通用型晶片未必能完全滿足所有使用情境, 因此由AI企業或終端設備商提出需求, 再由晶片設計及製造商共同開發的客製化AI晶片, 正逐漸成為半導體產業的新方向。
OpenAI近期也正積極擴大AI硬體及自有運算基礎設施布局。路透此前報導, Anthropic正在建立Custom Silicon Team並尋求客製化晶片合作夥伴, 顯示AI模型業者對專用AI晶片的需求正快速增加。

此外, Broadcom(AVGO-US)近期公布的業績也顯示, AI客製化晶片市場正在高速成長。該公司第三季AI半導體營收達167億美元, 其中73%來自客製化晶片; 公司預計第四季AI半導體營收將升至217億美元, 並預期AI半導體營收在2027財年及2028年連續翻倍, 分別達到1150億美元及2300億美元。Broadcom目前已為OpenAI、Anthropic及Google等AI業者開發客製化晶片, 並已開始出貨新一代Google TPU及OpenAI的Jalapeño晶片。
在這種產業趨勢下, 三星此次與Arm合作的意義不只在於爭取一筆端側AI晶片訂單, 更在於建立AI客製化晶片的完整服務能力。如果最終產品順利進入量產, 三星將可同時展示System LSI的SoC設計能力及Foundry的2奈米製程能力, 有助於日後爭取其他AI企業及科技公司的客製化晶片專案。
尤其是2奈米製程, 將成為這項合作的重要看點。三星希望藉由先進製程提高AI晶片的效能及能源效率, 而實際參與端側AI晶片的設計及量產, 也能讓三星累積以2奈米服務AI客戶的量產經驗。若產品最終成功商業化, 相關成果有望成為三星日後向其他客戶推廣2奈米代工能力的重要案例。
事實上, 三星目前已透過Arm等合作夥伴布局AI晶片及先進製程。三星晶圓代工此前就曾與Arm、ADTechnology及Rebellions合作開發AI CPU chiplet平台, 採用三星2奈米製程及先進封裝技術, 顯示三星正試圖利用2奈米製程切入不同AI運算市場。
三星目前也正在擴大企業內部AI應用。OpenAI今年6月宣布, 三星電子在韓國的全體員工及全球Device eXperience(DX)部門員工將使用ChatGPT Enterprise及Codex, 這是OpenAI迄今規模最大的企業部署案例之一。三星計畫將相關工具應用於研發、製造、行銷、產品開發及軟體等工作。
對三星而言, 若這款端側AI晶片最終由OpenAI等大型AI企業採用, 將具有更大的戰略價值。一方面可替系統LSI業務增加客製化SoC設計收入, 另一方面也可替晶圓代工業務導入高階AI客戶, 形成設計、製造及最終交付的一體化商業模式。
不過, 目前這項合作仍處於開發階段, OpenAI是否最終成為客戶、晶片的具體規格、出貨時間及量產規模均尚未獲得官方確認。市場因此仍需等待後續產品開發及客戶定案。
若最終順利量產, 三星將不僅取得一項端側AI晶片專案, 更可能藉此建立2奈米製程服務AI客戶的實績。在AI運算需求從資料中心向終端設備擴散之際, 三星與Arm的合作能否進一步轉化為更多客製化AI晶片訂單, 將成為其系統LSI與晶圓代工業務未來的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics (005930-KS) is deepening its partnership with chip architecture designer Arm to co‑develop a next‑generation edge artificial intelligence (AI) system‑on‑chip (SoC), with plans to mass‑produce it using Samsung’s 2‑nanometer process. Korean media report that Arm approved the project’s initial non‑recurring engineering (NRE) costs at the end of August, after which both parties formally kicked off joint development, indicating that the edge‑AI chip project has entered a substantive execution phase.

Industry sources say the collaboration will see Arm provide core design technologies such as the AI accelerator (AIC) architecture and RTL, convey final customer requirements to Samsung, and coordinate overall development progress. Samsung’s System LSI division will handle the detailed SoC design, while its Foundry division is slated to use the advanced 2‑nm process for subsequent volume production.

Notably, industry observers speculate that the ultimate customer for this custom chip could include OpenAI. However, neither Samsung, Arm nor OpenAI have officially confirmed OpenAI as the final customer, so the information should be treated as market and industry speculation.

The partnership uses a Limited Use License (LUL) model. In other words, the architecture and related technologies supplied by Arm are not free for Samsung to use in all products, but are restricted to development for specific customers and specific products. Arm’s role is primarily as a core technology provider and co‑development partner, not as a direct seller of the chip to the market.

From a business‑model perspective, Samsung will take charge of the work from SoC design through manufacturing, delivering the finished chip directly to the end customer and capturing commercial revenue. This gives Samsung the chance to earn from both its System LSI design and Foundry manufacturing businesses, leveraging its vertical integration advantage more than a pure foundry‑only contract would allow.

The backdrop of this collaboration is the shift of AI computing from cloud data centers toward smartphones, PCs and other edge devices. Traditional AI services rely heavily on cloud servers for inference and data processing, whereas edge AI can perform part of the computation on the device itself, reducing dependence on cloud compute, and improving latency, power consumption and data privacy.

As generative AI features start appearing in more consumer electronics, different devices demand varying AI compute power, power budgets, latency and cost. General‑purpose chips may not satisfy every use case, so custom AI chips driven by AI firms or device makers and co‑developed with chip designers and manufacturers are becoming a new direction for the semiconductor industry.

OpenAI has recently been actively expanding its AI hardware and in‑house compute infrastructure. Reuters previously reported that Anthropic is building a Custom Silicon Team and seeking custom‑chip partners, underscoring the rapid growth in demand for dedicated AI silicon among model developers.

Moreover, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) recently disclosed results that show the AI custom‑chip market is booming. The company’s Q3 AI semiconductor revenue hit $16.7 billion, with 73 % coming from custom chips; it expects Q4 AI semiconductor revenue to rise to $21.7 billion and projects AI semiconductor revenue to double in FY2027 and FY2028 to $115 billion and $230 billion respectively. Broadcom already develops custom chips for OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, and has begun shipping the next‑generation Google TPU and OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip.

In this industry trend, Samsung’s deal with Arm is about more than securing a single edge‑AI chip order; it is about building a full‑service capability for AI custom chips. If the product reaches volume production, Samsung can showcase both its System LSI SoC design expertise and its 2‑nm foundry capability, helping it win further custom‑chip projects from other AI firms and tech companies.

The 2‑nm process is a key focus of the collaboration. Samsung hopes the advanced node will boost AI chip performance and energy efficiency, and by actually participating in edge‑AI chip design and production, it can accumulate 2‑nm production experience for AI customers. Successful commercialization would provide a strong case study for Samsung to promote its 2‑nm services to other clients.

In fact, Samsung has already been positioning itself in AI chips and advanced nodes through partners like Arm. Its foundry previously collaborated with Arm, ADTechnology and Rebellions to develop an AI‑CPU chiplet platform using Samsung’s 2‑nm process and advanced packaging, indicating Samsung’s intent to leverage 2‑nm for various AI compute markets.

Samsung is also expanding internal AI usage. OpenAI announced in June that all Samsung Electronics employees in Korea and the global Device eXperience (DX) division will use ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex, one of OpenAI’s largest corporate deployments to date. Samsung plans to apply these tools across R&D, manufacturing, marketing, product development and software work.

For Samsung, if this edge‑AI chip is ultimately adopted by large AI firms such as OpenAI, it would have greater strategic value. It would boost custom SoC design revenue for its System LSI business and bring high‑end AI customers into its foundry business, creating an integrated model from design through manufacturing to final delivery.

However, the collaboration is still in the development stage; whether OpenAI becomes the customer, the chip’s exact specifications, shipment timeline and production volume have not been officially confirmed. The market must therefore await further product development and customer decisions.

If volume production succeeds, Samsung will not only secure an edge‑AI chip project but also establish a track record of serving AI customers with its 2‑nm process. As AI compute demand shifts from data centers to edge devices, the ability of Samsung and Arm’s partnership to translate into more custom AI chip orders will be a key indicator for the future of Samsung’s System LSI and foundry businesses.

items.title: 長鑫科技DRAM市占首破10%、躍居全球第4！2028年拚18%挑戰三星、SK海力士
paras: 中國DRAM大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 在全球記憶體市場的市占率持續攀升。市場研究機構Counterpoint Research近日發布最新全球DRAM市場分析指出，2026年第2季全球DRAM市場營收年增385%、季增57%，長鑫科技營收市占率則首度達到10%，排名全球第4。
從主要業者來看，三星電子(005930KS) 仍以38%的營收市占率居冠，SK海力士(000660KS) 以25%排名第2，美光科技(MU-US) 則以24%位居第3。長鑫科技則以10%市占率緊追在後，年增4個百分點、季增2個百分點。
這也是長鑫科技單季DRAM營收市占率首次達到雙位數。2023年時，長鑫科技全球DRAM營收市占率還不到1%，去年第2季則升至4%，今年第1季進一步攀升至8%，第2季再提高至10%。
Counterpoint Research今年8月初原先預估，長鑫科技2026年第2季DRAM營收市占率約為7%。
不過，隨著長鑫科技母公司長鑫科技8月底公布上半年財報，其業績表現明顯超出原先預期，因此Counterpoint在最新報告中將長鑫科技市占率修正至10%。
財報顯示，長鑫科技2026年上半年營收達1503.1億元人民幣，年增873.64%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤為776.05億元人民幣，相較去年同期虧損23.32億元，已扭虧為盈，且上半年業績已超越2025年全年。
根據已公布的第1季業績計算，長鑫科技第2季營收約995.1億元人民幣，年增977.4%、季增約95.9%；歸母淨利潤達528.43億元人民幣，年增由虧轉盈，季增113.4%。
相較之下，三星第2季營收171.5兆韓元，年增130%、季增28%；SK海力士營收79.3187兆韓元，年增257%、季增51%；美光2026會計年度第3季（截至5月28日）營收為414.56億美元，年增346%、季增74%。
這顯示長鑫科技第2季營收的年增與季增幅度，均明顯高於全球前三大DRAM業者。

三大DRAM廠轉向HBM 長鑫科技趁勢擴充常規DRAM

不過，三星、SK海力士與美光的營收增速低於整體DRAM市場，與其產能配置變化有關。三大DRAM業者自去年第4季起，將更多產能轉向毛利率較高、AI加速器所需的高頻寬記憶體（HBM），使常規DRAM產品的產出減少。
美光此前曾表示，生產1份HBM3E需要消耗3份DRAM產能。隨著常規DRAM供應縮減，相關產品價格大幅上漲，最新研究顯示，常規DRAM的利潤率目前已與HBM持平，甚至超越HBM。
在此背景下，主要生產常規DRAM的長鑫科技迅速擴充產能，進一步受惠於市場供應吃緊與價格上漲。
相關報導指出，長鑫科技DRAM產品定價僅比南韓與美國同類產品低5%至10%，並未採取市場新進業者常見的大幅折價策略，代表其營收成長主要反映供應受限環境下的實際銷量增加，而非依靠價格戰搶占市場。

DDR5效能縮小差距 長鑫科技成本劣勢仍超過30%

在產品性能方面，2026年2月Hardware Unboxed進行的遊戲基準測試顯示，長鑫科技消費級DDR5產品的表現已與三星、SK海力士同類產品大致相當。
長鑫科技目前也已量產最新LPDDR6記憶體，首款產品目標速率為12,800 Mbps（12.8 Gbps），符合JEDEC標準，但比SK海力士採用1c製程的LPDDR6產品14.4 Gbps設計上限低約11%。
SK海力士LPDDR6採用第6代10奈米級（1c）製程，並導入EUV微影技術，相較LPDDR5X速度提升33%，功耗效率提升超過20%。
由於艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 的EUV曝光機及部分高階浸沒式DUV設備對中國出口受到限制，長鑫科技目前DRAM產品製造路線仍依賴DUV微影技術，在一定程度上限制技術演進。
目前三星、SK海力士與美光的高階DRAM產品均已推進至第5代10奈米級（1β／1b nm）製程。其中，三星與SK海力士自第4代10奈米級（1α／1a nm）製程便開始導入EUV，美光則自第6代10奈米級（1γ／1-gamma）製程開始導入EUV。
雖然DRAM製造商可以透過DUV多重曝光，達到類似EUV單次曝光的效果，但額外曝光可能增加位置誤差，累積後影響良率，同時也會拉長生產週期並推升製造成本。
根據SemiAnalysis建模以及晨星分析師Wei Jingjie的獨立成本分析，長鑫科技每位元的結構性成本劣勢，相較三星、SK海力士與美光平均水準超過30%。
即使存在成本劣勢，在常規DRAM供應吃緊、價格大幅上漲的環境下，長鑫科技今年上半年主營業務毛利率仍高達84.84%。

15%市占率成關鍵 長鑫科技能否跨過生存門檻？

對長鑫科技而言，10%並非最關鍵的市占率數字，15%才是另一個重要門檻。
Counterpoint Research研究總監Hwang Min-sung指出，長鑫科技必須跨過15%的市場佔有率門檻，才能取得持續投資下一代晶圓廠所需的資金。
這項判斷具有歷史依據。台灣DRAM業者南亞科(2408-TW) 、華亞科與茂德，在2008年全球市場佔有率跌破15%後，逐漸失去競爭生存能力。
Hwang Min-sung表示，當DRAM業者市占率低於15%，將難以為下一代晶圓廠取得融資，市占率可能進一步萎縮至約3%，最終轉為利基型業者。因此，15%被視為長鑫科技必須跨越的重要界線。
然而，若只依賴常規DRAM市場，長鑫科技要達到15%市占率可能面臨挑戰。原因在於，當三星、SK海力士與美光預計在2028年前後完成HBM產能擴充、供需恢復平衡後，部分產能可能重新轉向常規DRAM市場，屆時常規DRAM價格可能下滑，長鑫科技目前的成本劣勢也將成為影響利潤率的重要因素。

長鑫科技拚2028年市占18% 伺服器DRAM成布局重點

從營收結構來看，長鑫科技目前約98%的營收仍來自常規DRAM產品，包括DDR4、DDR5、LPDDR5X，以及最新量產的LPDDR6。HBM目前尚未實現量產銷售，使長鑫科技未來的產品結構與利潤率面臨一定脆弱性。
為降低對消費型DRAM的依賴，長鑫科技正積極擴大伺服器DRAM出貨，其伺服器市場營收占比已從2024年的8.4%提升至2025年的26.5%，持續向更高價值鏈推進。
最新消息顯示，長鑫科技已與字節跳動、騰訊控股(00700-HK) 及百度(09888-HK) 等中國企業簽署長期協議，這些中國雲端基礎設施業者已成為長鑫科技較穩定且價值較高的客戶。
其中，字節跳動於2026年7月與長鑫科技簽署一份價值超過70億美元、為期5年的伺服器DRAM供應協議。阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 則持有長鑫科技約5%股權，同時也是其主要客戶之一。
野村分析師Donnie Teng預估，長鑫科技全球DRAM市占率將在2028年底達到18%，跨過15%的關鍵門檻。投資人Dan Niles則提出更積極的看法，認為中國到2030年可能占全球DRAM市場30%。
相較之下，Counterpoint Research的基準預測較為保守。該機構在長鑫科技IPO時預估，其2028年DRAM位元市占率約為11%，並預計到2035年才達到15%的營收市占率門檻，反映長鑫科技未來可能受到常規DRAM市場環境轉弱及成本劣勢影響，增速將逐步放緩。
長鑫科技今年7月已完成科創板IPO，取得近560億元人民幣融資，資金主要用於擴充產能及下一代技術研發，為後續提升市場競爭力與市占率提供資金支持。

items.title: 美股七巨頭首度與市場動能背離！資金轉向記憶體、半導體 科技股領導地位生變
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks' Magnificent Seven Diverge from Market Momentum for the First Time; Capital Shifts to Memory Chips and Semiconductors, Changing Tech Leadership
paras: 美股市場長期由大型科技股引領的格局正在出現變化。「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）近期首度與美國股市動能因子呈現反向走勢，顯示這批過去主導市場漲勢的權值股，與高動能股票之間的聯動性正在減弱。
根據《Seeking Alpha》報導，Sherwood News彙整了美股七巨頭ETF(MAGS-US) 與安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子(MTUM-US) 每日價格變動的21個交易日滾動相關係數，發現這項短期衡量指標近期已轉為負值，終結了AI帶動的多頭市場期間，大型科技股長期呈現的高度同步走勢。
美股七巨頭ETF主要追蹤蘋果(AAPL-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 等7大科技企業；安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子則持有近期表現優於大盤的大型股與中型股。
多年來，這兩組股票的漲跌大致同步，因為美股七巨頭一直是市場因子領先地位與指數報酬的重要支柱。
不過，近期市場資金開始轉向記憶體晶片、其他半導體類股，以及標普500指數中更廣泛的成分股，市場輪動也使美股七巨頭不再以過去的「整體性」同步交易。
美股七巨頭ETF與安碩 MSCI 美國動能 因子的相關係數轉負，代表科技七雄已不再是市場動能交易的主要驅動力量。當高動能股票持續上漲時，美股七巨頭可能反而落後；而當動能交易降溫時，美股七巨頭則可能相對抗跌。
這項訊號持續時間短，且可能迅速反轉。不過，對於這個過去曾主導市場走勢的股票群體而言，這仍是一次罕見的統計性首次。
其他「科技七雄」相關基金包括：Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF(MAGX-US) 、Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bull 2X ETF(QQQU-US) 及Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bear 1X ETF(QQQD-US) 。
paras_en: The long‑standing pattern of U.S. equities being led by large‑cap tech stocks is changing. The “Magnificent Seven” have recently moved in the opposite direction of the U.S. market momentum factor for the first time, indicating that the once‑dominant heavyweight stocks are losing their linkage with high‑momentum shares.

According to a report on Seeking Alpha, Sherwood News compiled a 21‑day rolling correlation of daily price changes between the Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US) and the MSCI USA Momentum Factor (MTUM‑US). The short‑term metric has turned negative, ending the period of AI‑driven bull market where large‑cap tech stocks moved in tight sync.

The Magnificent Seven ETF tracks the seven major tech companies Apple (AAPL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US). The MSCI USA Momentum Factor holds large‑ and mid‑cap stocks that have recently outperformed the broader market.
For years the price movements of these two groups have been roughly in step, because the Magnificent Seven have been a key pillar of factor leadership and index returns in the market.

However, capital is now flowing into memory‑chip makers, other semiconductor stocks, and a broader set of S&P 500 constituents, causing a rotation that breaks the former “overall” synchronicity of the Magnificent Seven trades.

The correlation turning negative means the seven tech giants are no longer the primary drivers of market‑momentum trading. When high‑momentum stocks keep rising, the Magnificent Seven may lag; when momentum trading cools, they may hold up relative to the market.
This signal is likely short‑lived and could reverse quickly, but for a group that has historically steered market direction, it remains a rare statistical first.

Other funds linked to the “Tech Seven” include the Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGX‑US), the Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bull 2X ETF (QQQU‑US) and the Direxion Daily Magnificent 7 Bear 1X ETF (QQQD‑US).

items.title: 發債太猛、買家退場！伊爾艾朗：全球公債拋售未完 殖利率仍面臨上行壓力
items.title_en: Bond Issuance Frenzy, Buyers Walk Out! Mohamed El‑Erian: Global Sovereign‑Bond Sell‑off Unfinished, Yields Still Face Upside Pressure
paras: 知名經濟學家伊爾艾朗(Mohamed El-Erian)周五(4日)表示，投資人應預期全球公債拋售潮將持續，原因在於市場正面臨政府、大型雲端服務商及企業大量發債，但可靠買家的承接能力卻日益不足，形成根本性的供需失衡。
伊爾艾朗在義大利切爾諾比奧(Cernobbio)舉行的Ambrosetti論壇期間表示：「我看不到美國有任何立即進行財政整頓的意願。因此，我認為殖利率仍將持續面臨上行壓力。」
全球公債本周遭遇猛烈拋售，因市場日益擔憂通膨及升息，多個主要國家的公債殖利率陡升至數十年高點。債券價格與殖利率呈反向走勢。
伊爾艾朗現任賓州大學華頓商學院Rene M. Kern實務教授，也是安聯(Allianz)首席經濟顧問。
伊爾艾朗表示，目前市場運作本身並沒有出現問題，但美國公債的「可靠買家與長期持有者」正面臨壓力。他說：「基於地緣政治因素，中國已不再像過去那樣願意買進。日本和波灣國家則面臨各自的國內問題。」
伊爾艾朗也提到，挪威主權財富基金正重新檢視手上的美國公債配置。
他表示：「規模雖然不大，但傳統持有者與買家正變得不那麼可靠，這個訊號非常重要。如果看看政府、大型雲端服務商以及企業即將發行的債務規模，遠遠超過市場能仰賴的可靠買家承接能力。」
「這就是利率承受壓力的原因。與其說是通膨、聯準會(Fed)公信力或其他市場提出的因素，不如說更主要是根本性的供需失衡。」

點名英國、日本、法國債務風險較高

伊爾艾朗表示，七大工業國(G7)之中，英國、日本及法國尤其容易受到主權債務問題衝擊。
他說：「無論從數據或其他條件來看，尤其是英國，我稱它為『高Beta國家』。也就是美國利率只要小幅波動，英國的利率波動幅度就會大得多。」
伊爾艾朗也指出，歐洲債市的焦點正在轉移，法國已成為債市關注的核心。
他表示：「過去大家擔心的是義大利。現在義大利的債券殖利率已低於法國，市場焦點轉向歐元區兩大核心國家之一，而不再是歐元區周邊國家。相較於過去，這樣的轉變非常值得關注。」

批美財政部干預債市「走太遠」

伊爾艾朗也批評，川普政府試圖干預市場結果及貨幣政策的做法已經「走得太遠」。
美國財政部上月宣布，在長天期政府借款殖利率飆升至數十年高點後，將至少把長天期美債回購規模擴大一倍。美國副總統范斯(JD Vance)周四則呼籲Fed降息，再度對央行施壓。
伊爾艾朗形容這些行動「令人遺憾」，「這顯示財政部已進入一種思維模式，相信自己不僅可以提供資訊及影響市場結果，甚至可以把市場結果強加於市場。我認為這已經走得太遠。」
他進一步指出：「現在的問題是，要如何從這種做法退回來？我認為結果已經很清楚。這是一個規模龐大的市場，除非你願意承受意料之外的後果與附帶損害，否則不可能長期以人為方式影響它。」
伊爾艾朗表示，今年5月接替鮑爾(Jerome Powell)、由美國總統川普欽點出任Fed主席的華許(Kevin Warsh)，將會「聽到」范斯要求降息的呼聲。
他說：「這讓你感受到，住房負擔能力已變得如此重要的政治議題，因此壓力一定會存在。我認為真正的問題不是『這對Fed意味著什麼』，而是『這對財政部意味著什麼』。因為他希望降息的原因與房貸市場有關。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，目前市場對Fed 9月會議的預期接近五五波，升息與維持利率不變的機率大致相當。

讚華許在傑克森霍爾「做對三件事」

伊爾艾朗表示，就他看來，華許上周在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)央行年會發表演說時，已經「做對了三件事」。
他說：「第一，他回應了外界對其政策反應函數的疑慮。」
「第二，他警告不要過度依賴前瞻指引，以及避免出現『鏡廳效應』(hall of mirrors)。我同意他的看法，前瞻指引已經走得太遠。」
伊爾艾朗認為，華許第三項表態雖然獲得最少關注，卻可能是最重要的一點，「他將人工智慧(AI)描述為潛在的生產要素，這意味著AI可能對供給面產生巨大影響。」
伊爾艾朗說，華許能在半小時內清楚闡述這三項重點，「我認為這是一場做得非常好的演說」。
paras_en: Renowned economist Mohamed El‑Erian said on Friday (the 4th) that investors should expect the global sovereign‑bond sell‑off to continue because markets are facing massive debt issuance by governments, large cloud‑service providers and corporations, while reliable buyers are becoming increasingly scarce, creating a fundamental supply‑demand imbalance.

Speaking at the Ambrosetti Forum in Cernobbio, Italy, El‑Erian said, "I see no willingness in the United States to undertake an immediate fiscal adjustment. Therefore, I think yields will continue to face upward pressure."

Global sovereign bonds suffered a sharp sell‑off this week as markets grew more worried about inflation and rate hikes, with yields on major countries’ bonds soaring to multi‑decade highs. Bond prices move inversely to yields.
El‑Erian is currently a professor of practice at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and the chief economic adviser to Allianz.

He noted that the market itself is not malfunctioning, but the "reliable buyers and long‑term holders" of U.S. Treasuries are under pressure. He added, "Because of geopolitical factors, China is no longer as willing to buy as before. Japan and the Gulf states each face their own domestic issues."
El‑Erian also mentioned that Norway’s sovereign wealth fund is re‑examining its U.S. Treasury holdings.

He said, "Although the scale is not huge, traditional holders and buyers are becoming less reliable, and that signal is very important. If you look at the amount of debt that governments, large cloud providers and corporations are about to issue, it far exceeds the capacity of reliable buyers to absorb it."
"That is why rates are under pressure. It is less about inflation, the Fed’s credibility or other market‑talked factors, and more about a fundamental supply‑demand mismatch."
He singled out higher debt risk in the United Kingdom, Japan and France among the G7 nations.
He said, "By any metric, especially for the UK, I call it a ‘high‑beta’ country. A small move in U.S. rates translates into a much larger swing in British rates."
El‑Erian also noted that the focus in European bond markets is shifting, with France now at the core of attention.

He explained, "Earlier the concern was Italy. Now Italy’s bond yields are lower than France’s, so the market’s focus has moved to one of the two core Euro‑area economies, no longer the peripheral ones. Compared with the past, this shift is very noteworthy."
He criticized the Trump administration’s attempts to intervene in market outcomes and monetary policy as having "gone too far."

The U.S. Treasury announced last month that, after long‑term government borrowing yields surged to multi‑decade peaks, it would at least double the scale of its long‑term Treasury buy‑backs. Vice‑President JD Vance on Thursday urged the Fed to cut rates, again pressing the central bank.

El‑Erian described these actions as "regrettable" and said, "It shows the Treasury has adopted a mindset that it can not only provide information and influence market outcomes, but even impose outcomes on the market. I think that has gone too far."

He added, "The question now is how to retreat from this approach. The result is clear: this is a massive market, and unless you are willing to accept unexpected consequences and collateral damage, you cannot influence it artificially over the long term."
El‑Erian said that in May, Kevin Warsh, who succeeded Jerome Powell and was hand‑picked by President Trump to become Fed chair, will "hear" calls from Vance to cut rates.

He noted, "That makes you feel how housing affordability has become such a political issue, so pressure will inevitably be there. The real question is not ‘what this means for the Fed,’ but ‘what it means for the Treasury,’ because his desire to cut rates stems from the mortgage market."
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market’s odds for a rate hike versus holding steady at the September Fed meeting are roughly 50‑50.
El‑Erian said that, in his view, Warsh last week at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium got "three things right."
He said, "First, he responded to external doubts about his policy reaction function."
"Second, he warned against over‑reliance on forward guidance and cautioned against a ‘hall of mirrors’ effect. I agree with him that forward guidance has gone too far."

El‑Erian believes Warsh’s third point, though receiving the least attention, may be the most important: "He described artificial intelligence as a potential factor of production, implying AI could have a huge impact on the supply side."
He said Warsh was able to clearly articulate these three points in half an hour, "I think it was a very well‑executed speech."

items.title: 輝達砸錢AI客戶恐成泡沫？經濟學家反駁：反而讓AI熱潮更持久
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業持續吸引巨額資金投入，輝達(NVDA-US) 不僅是AI晶片供應商，也逐步成為產業重要的資金提供者，引發擔憂。然而，知名經濟學家Tyler Cowen認為，輝達大舉投入資金支持最終會購買其晶片的AI企業，未必代表市場存在泡沫，反而可能讓這波AI熱潮更具持續性。
根據《Benzinga》報導，Cowen週五（4日）接受「Prof G Markets」Podcast訪問時表示，可以將輝達視為AI產業的某種「最後貸款人」或「最後買家」。
他指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 與Meta(META-US) 也扮演類似角色。
Cowen認為，新技術在發展初期往往需要資金協助才能建立規模，而目前大量資金持續流入AI產業，反而提高這項技術長期成功的可能性。
值得注意的是，Cowen目前是Anthropic經濟顧問委員會成員。輝達去年已承諾，將透過更廣泛的運算合作夥伴關係，對Anthropic投資最高100億美元。

輝達不只賣GPU 也開始協助客戶籌資

外界對AI熱潮的其中一項疑慮，是輝達及其他科技巨頭一方面向AI產業提供資金，另一方面又從這些企業購買晶片與運算基礎設施的需求中受益。
輝達如今已不只是銷售GPU。8月10日，輝達與Apollo、貝萊德(BLK-US) 、黑石(BX-US) 、Brookfield、高盛集團(GS-US) 及KKR (KKR-US) 合作推出融資平台，目標是為AI基礎設施調動超過5000億美元的第三方資金。
一週後，輝達又同意為SB Energy位於俄亥俄州資料中心園區、與OpenAI相關的租賃債務提供最高1050億美元的擔保，同時投資15億美元於SB Energy，且輝達將成為該園區獨家AI運算供應商。
換言之，輝達正運用自身的財務實力及與華爾街的關係，協助客戶取得建造資料中心與運算基礎設施所需的資金，而這些設施最終又將運行於輝達的系統之上。
不過，Cowen認為，這並不代表AI熱潮是由人為資金堆砌而成。他指出，新技術在初期往往需要大量資本才能起步，「新事物會自行建立起來」。

Cowen：AI是不是泡沫不是重點 應問「產品有沒有用？」

談到AI是否形成泡沫時，Cowen直言，這可能是「錯誤的討論」。
他以1920年代的汽車產業為例指出，當時許多汽車製造商最終倒閉，就如同後來許多網路公司消失一樣，但這並不代表背後的技術本身失去價值。
因此，在Cowen看來，投資人真正應該問的是一個更簡單的問題：「這項產品有效嗎？」
對此，他給出的答案相當明確：「是的。」
另一方面，Polymarket交易者也認為AI熱潮短期內崩潰的可能性不高，目前給予AI泡沫在今年破裂的機率為12%。
不過，這並不代表投資人不會蒙受損失。Cowen指出，如果AI熱潮反轉，以債務融資興建的資料中心可能帶來「不利的總體經濟後果」，包括資本損失與償付能力問題。
但他認為，即使AI投資熱潮最終逆轉，其可能造成的衝擊仍遠低於2008年金融危機的程度。

items.title: PIMCO績優基金撤出「科技七巨頭」 轉押亞洲AI設備供應商
items.title_en: PIMCO Top-Performing Fund Pulls Out of "Big Tech Seven" and Shifts to Asian AI Equipment Suppliers
paras: 《彭博》報導，PIMCO旗下績優基金正降低對美國大型科技股的配置，轉向亞洲AI設備供應商、中國金融股及醫療保健類股，尋找下一波投資機會。
PIMCO旗艦基金「平衡收益與成長基金」經理人Emmanuel Sharef表示，美國大型科技公司的估值偏高，加上AI投資支出大幅攀升，不僅推高企業債務負擔，也使獲利前景更加不明朗，因此基金目前低配多數超大型雲端服務商及「科技七巨頭」。
Sharef指出，投資人不必持有市場上最昂貴的股票，也能掌握特定產業趨勢。根據《彭博》彙整資料，這檔基金資產規模接近190億美元，過去3年績效超越97%的同類基金。
該基金採取系統化選股策略，依據價值、品質、動能及成長等指標配置個股。目前仍加碼亞洲市場，主要看好當地企業的獲利成長，以及亞洲公司在AI供應鏈下游環節的布局。只要企業獲利維持強勁，基金預計將延續這項配置方向。
Sharef表示，AI資本支出的擴張規模相當龐大，可望帶動晶片、半導體零組件、散熱設備、纜線互連、光學設備、電源供應器、營建設備及金屬等資料中心相關產品需求。
除亞洲AI供應鏈外，該基金過去約18個月也持續增加生技及生命科學類股部位。
Sharef認為，大型生技公司為分散藥物研發管線而增加併購，已促使部分企業獲利預期獲得上修；隨著AI技術持續發展，未來也可能協助治療更多類型的疾病。
在中國市場方面，金融股是該基金配置比重最大的產業，主要原因是波動相對較低，基金同時也看好原物料類股。受黃金及銅價上漲帶動，MSCI中國原物料指數過去1個月上漲約7.1%，表現超越多數主要產業類股。
Sharef指出，中國的資源開採及原物料企業不僅在資料中心建設中扮演重要角色，也涉及稀土等關鍵資源供應。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reports that PIMCO’s top-performing funds are reducing their exposure to large U.S. technology stocks and turning toward Asian AI equipment suppliers, Chinese financial stocks, and healthcare equities in search of the next wave of investment opportunities.

PIMCO’s flagship Balanced Income and Growth Fund manager Emmanuel Sharef said valuations for large U.S. tech companies are too high, and the surge in AI spending is not only raising corporate debt loads but also clouding profit outlooks, so the fund is currently underweight most mega‑cap cloud service providers and the "Big Tech Seven."

Sharef noted that investors don’t need to hold the most expensive stocks in the market to capture sector trends. According to Bloomberg’s compiled data, the fund’s assets are close to $19 billion, and its performance over the past three years has outpaced 97 % of peer funds.

The fund uses a systematic stock‑selection approach, allocating to individual securities based on value, quality, momentum and growth metrics. It continues to increase its Asian exposure, favoring local companies’ earnings growth and their positioning in downstream AI supply‑chain segments. As long as corporate earnings stay strong, the fund expects to maintain this allocation direction.

Sharef said the scale of AI‑related capital spending is massive and is expected to drive demand for chips, semiconductor components, cooling equipment, cabling and interconnects, optical devices, power supplies, construction gear and metals used in data centers.
Beyond the Asian AI supply chain, the fund has been steadily adding biotech and life‑science stocks over roughly the past 18 months.

Sharef believes large biotech firms are expanding M&A to diversify drug pipelines, prompting upward revisions to earnings expectations for some companies; as AI technology advances, it could also help treat a broader range of diseases in the future.

In China, financial stocks make up the fund’s largest sector allocation because of their relatively low volatility, and the fund is also bullish on commodities. Driven by rising gold and copper prices, the MSCI China Materials Index has risen about 7.1 % over the past month, outperforming most major sector indices.
Sharef pointed out that China’s resource‑extraction and materials companies play a key role in data‑center construction and are also involved in supplying critical resources such as rare earths.

items.title: 川普提結束俄烏戰爭方案！美國特使將訪莫斯科、基輔提交
items.title_en: Trump Proposes End to Russia‑Ukraine War; U.S. Envoy to Visit Moscow and Kyiv
paras: 俄烏戰事尋求外交突破之際，美國總統特使威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）與美國總統川普女婿庫許納（Jared Kushner）預計展開俄烏訪問行程。俄羅斯方面消息人士週五（4日）透露，兩人將於9月5日至6日先後前往俄羅斯莫斯科及烏克蘭基輔。
美國總統川普表示，威特科夫與庫許納此行將向俄羅斯提交結束俄烏衝突的方案。
俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）週四（3日）表示，俄烏衝突仍存在解決的可能，但最終能否實現，取決於參與衝突的雙方。

澤倫斯基：談判期間不對俄發動空襲

烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）4日證實，威特科夫與庫許納近日將訪問俄羅斯，並預計於9月6日前往烏克蘭。
澤倫斯基表示，烏方正為兩人的到訪進行準備，並已與負責對美外交工作的團隊召開會議。
他指出，與過去美方外交人員訪問期間的安排相同，烏克蘭將確保俄羅斯領空在相關時段維持正常運行，以保障美方談判人員安全抵達。不過，澤倫斯基強調，烏克蘭關心的是談判人員的安全，而非俄羅斯本身。
澤倫斯基表示，在威特科夫與庫許納訪問及談判期間，烏方不會發動空中打擊；同時，俄羅斯也應採取對等措施，在談判以及處理此次訪問所需後勤安排期間停止空襲。
他說，烏克蘭希望此次訪問及與美方的談判能夠具備建設性與實質內容，並尋找推動戰爭結束的實際方案。烏克蘭也將關注威特科夫與庫許納提出的方案，以及俄羅斯方面的回應。

烏克蘭安局遭俄無人機襲擊 威特科夫訪問行程恐生變

不過，在美方特使準備展開訪問之際，基輔安全情勢再度受到關注，出於安全擔憂，威特科夫似乎正在考慮代替訪問的其他方案。
澤倫斯基4日在社群媒體發文表示，位於基輔市中心的烏克蘭國家安全局（SBU）總部當天遭俄軍無人機襲擊。
澤倫斯基指出，俄軍無人機擊中位於聖索菲亞教堂對面的國家安全局總部大樓，並稱攻擊目標是局長辦公室。烏克蘭國家緊急情況局及執法部門已在現場展開救援與處置工作。
他表示，已與烏克蘭國家安全局局長 Oleksandr Poklad 通話，並指示相關部門準備在適當時機對俄方作出「有力且對等的回應」，烏克蘭軍方將提供支持。
烏克蘭外交部長瑟比加（Andrii Sybiha）同日表示，俄軍襲擊國家安全局總部是重大升級，烏方必須作出堅決回應，並呼籲國際夥伴予以譴責及加大對俄羅斯的壓力。
與此同時，烏克蘭《基輔獨立報》引述匿名消息人士指出，俄羅斯方面並不希望威特科夫與庫許納前往基輔，兩人被告知當地存在安全風險。
目前烏克蘭領空仍處於關閉狀態，威特科夫原本計畫搭乘飛機前往烏克蘭，但在最新安全情勢下，訪問安排可能出現變化。
paras_en: While seeking a diplomatic breakthrough in the Russia‑Ukraine conflict, U.S. President Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff and Trump’s son‑in‑law Jared Kushner are expected to embark on a visit to Russia and Ukraine. Russian sources on Friday (4th) revealed that the two will travel to Moscow and Kyiv on September 5‑6, respectively.
President Trump stated that Witkoff and Kushner’s trip will present Russia with a proposal to end the Russia‑Ukraine conflict.
On Thursday (3rd), Russian President Vladimir Putin said that a solution to the Russia‑Ukraine conflict still exists, but whether it can ultimately be achieved depends on the parties involved.

Zelensky: No airstrikes on Russia during negotiations
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed on the 4th that Witkoff and Kushner will visit Russia soon and are expected to go to Ukraine on September 6.
Zelensky said Ukraine is preparing for the visit and has held a meeting with the team responsible for U.S. diplomatic work.

He noted that, as with past visits by U.S. diplomatic personnel, Ukraine will ensure Russian airspace remains operational during the relevant periods to guarantee the safe arrival of U.S. negotiators. However, Zelensky emphasized that Ukraine’s concern is the safety of the negotiators, not Russia itself.

Zelensky stated that during Witkoff and Kushner’s visit and negotiations, Ukraine will not launch air strikes; at the same time, Russia should take reciprocal measures and halt airstrikes during the negotiations and the logistical arrangements for the visit.

He said Ukraine hopes the visit and negotiations with the U.S. will be constructive and substantive, and will seek practical solutions to end the war. Ukraine will also monitor the proposals put forward by Witkoff and Kushner and Russia’s response.

Ukrainian security agency attacked by Russian drones; Witkoff’s visit may change
However, as the U.S. envoy prepares to travel, Kyiv’s security situation has again drawn attention, and for security concerns, Witkoff appears to be considering alternative arrangements.
On the 4th, Zelensky posted on social media that the Ukrainian Security Service (SBU) headquarters in central Kyiv was hit by a Russian drone that day.

Zelensky noted that the Russian drone struck the SBU headquarters building opposite St. Sophia Cathedral, targeting the director’s office. Ukrainian emergency and law‑enforcement agencies have begun rescue and cleanup operations on site.

He said he had spoken with SBU Director Oleksandr Poklad and instructed relevant departments to prepare a “strong and equal response” to Russia when the time is right, with the Ukrainian military providing support.

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha also said on the same day that the attack on the SBU headquarters was a major escalation, that Ukraine must respond decisively, and called on international partners to condemn the attack and increase pressure on Russia.
At the same time, the Kyiv Independent quoted anonymous sources saying that Russia does not want Witkoff and Kushner to go to Kyiv, and that they were told there were security risks locally.
Ukraine’s airspace remains closed, and Witkoff originally planned to fly to Ukraine, but the latest security situation may change the visit arrangements.

items.title: 美軍18人陣亡、戰費逾375億美元 川普仍稱伊朗戰爭「小菜一碟」
items.title_en: 18 U.S. Service Members Killed, War Cost Over $37.5 Billion; Trump Still Calls the Iran War “A Piece of Cake”
paras: 美國總統川普周五(4日)表示，伊朗衝突對美國而言只是「小菜一碟」，並為副總統范斯(JD Vance)辯護。范斯日前表示，中東持續數月、時斷時續的攻擊不應被稱為「戰爭」。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室被問及范斯前一天的談話時表示，美國目前對伊朗的攻擊是「間歇性」進行，「很多人不把它稱為戰爭」。這場衝突已耗費美國納稅人逾375億美元，並造成18名美軍官兵死亡。
川普說：「我可以理解他的意思。」他接著表示：「我稱它為軍事衝突，因為對我們而言只是小菜一碟，沒什麼大不了的。」
范斯周四在白宮新聞簡報會上拒絕以「戰爭」形容美國與伊朗之間的戰鬥，並避談這場已持續六個月的衝突是否會在11月期中選舉前結束。共和黨正試圖在這次選舉中保住在國會的微弱多數優勢。
當被問到戰爭是否可能在選民於11月3日投票前結束時，范斯的回應是：「我不會稱它為戰爭。現在沒有正在進行的交火。」
不過，就在范斯發表這番說法之際，伊朗周四仍向美國在波斯灣的盟友科威特發動攻擊，以報復美國本周稍早對伊朗發動的一連串空襲。
川普周五與記者交談時還表示，與美國近年參與的其他戰爭相比，美國在伊朗衝突中的死亡人數相對較低。這場戰爭始於2月28日，美國與以色列迄今僅對伊朗發動空襲，尚未向伊朗境內部署地面部隊。
川普說：「我們處理了委內瑞拉，也處理了這件事。在委內瑞拉，我們沒有損失任何人。」這裡指的是美國1月以軍事行動抓補委內瑞拉前總統馬杜洛(Nicolás Maduro)，並將他押送至紐約面臨聯邦毒品販運指控。
川普接著說：「而這次，我們失去了18人。在越南，我們失去了10萬人。在其他衝突中，我們失去了數萬人。」
不過，根據美國國家檔案局紀錄，越戰期間共有58,220名美國武裝部隊成員死亡。
當記者追問，已有18名美軍官兵死亡的情況下，如何仍能將這場衝突形容為「小菜一碟」時，川普重申他的論點——這場戰爭已成功削弱伊朗的核計畫。
川普說：「伊朗不會擁有核武，因為如果他們擁有，你現在可能就不會站在這裡了。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that the conflict with Iran is merely “a piece of cake” for America and defended Vice President JD Vance, who recently said the months‑long, intermittent attacks in the Middle East should not be called a “war.”

When asked about Vance’s remarks in the Oval Office, Trump said the U.S. attack on Iran is being carried out “intermittently” and “many people don’t call it a war.” He noted the conflict has cost U.S. taxpayers more than $37.5 billion and has resulted in 18 American service members being killed.
Trump said, “I can understand his point.” He added, “I call it a military conflict because for us it’s just a piece of cake, nothing big.”

Vance on Thursday at a White House briefing refused to label the fighting between the United States and Iran as a war and dodged questions about whether the six‑month‑old conflict will end before the November midterm election, as Republicans try to preserve their slim congressional majority.
When asked whether the war could end before voters head to the polls on Nov. 3, Vance replied, “I wouldn’t call it a war. There’s no active fighting right now.”
Nevertheless, as Vance made that statement, Iran on Thursday still launched an attack on the U.S. ally Kuwait in the Persian Gulf in retaliation for a series of U.S. airstrikes earlier in the week.

Trump told reporters that, compared with other wars the United States has been involved in recently, the death toll in the Iran conflict is relatively low. The war began on Feb. 28, and the U.S. and Israel have so far only carried out airstrikes against Iran, with no ground troops deployed inside the country.

Trump said, “We dealt with Venezuela, and we dealt with this. In Venezuela we didn’t lose anyone.” He was referring to the January U.S. military operation that captured former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and brought him to New York on federal drug‑trafficking charges.
He continued, “This time we lost 18. In Vietnam we lost 100,000. In other conflicts we lost tens of thousands.”
However, records from the U.S. National Archives show that 58,220 American armed‑force members died during the Vietnam War.

When pressed on how he could still describe the conflict as “a piece of cake” after 18 service members had died, Trump reiterated his argument that the war has successfully weakened Iran’s nuclear program.
Trump said, “Iran will not have a nuclear weapon, because if they had one, you might not be standing here right now.”

items.title: 川普：魏科夫、庫許納將出訪 推動俄烏和平談判
items.title_en: Trump: Witkoff and Kushner to Travel to Promote Russia‑Ukraine Peace Talks
paras: 《路透社》報導，美國總統川普周五(4日)告訴記者，美國特使魏科夫(Steve Witkoff)及其女婿庫許納(Jared Kushner)將出訪，試圖促成俄羅斯與烏克蘭達成和平協議。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室發表談話時暗示，美國已提出一項新的具體方案，目標是結束這場如今已進入第五年的戰爭。不過，他沒有透露方案內容，也沒有說明魏科夫與庫許納將前往烏克蘭、俄羅斯，還是兩國都會前往。
據美國有線電視新聞網(CNN)，一位美國官員當日稍早表示，魏科夫和庫許納計劃未來幾天將造訪莫斯科及烏克蘭首都基輔，試圖推動兩國衝突的外交解決方案。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周五表示，兩人將在訪問莫斯科後，於周日飛往烏克蘭。
川普表示，「我們有一個和平方案。」「我派魏科夫和庫許納前去，他們都是非常優秀的談判代表。他們一直做得非常出色，我們派他們去看看能不能取得一些進展。而且我們很有可能做到。」
川普政府過去試圖結束俄烏戰爭的努力大多沒有取得成果，談判近幾個月也陷入停滯。
8月底，美國中央情報局(CIA)局長John Ratcliffe前往莫斯科，部分目的就是敦促俄方對和平解決方案進行考慮，路透社及其他多家媒體當時曾報導此事。
多數西方情報官員認為，俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)並無意在短期內達成協議。烏克蘭情報部門則認為，普丁近期更可能升級戰事，而不是讓戰爭降溫。
周五，一架俄羅斯無人機擊中烏克蘭安全局(SBU)位於基輔總部。這是戰爭爆發以來遭到攻擊的最高調目標之一。
paras_en: Reuters reported that U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday (the 4th) that U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and his son‑in‑law Jared Kushner will travel in an effort to broker a peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine.

Speaking from the Oval Office, Trump hinted that the United States has put forward a new concrete proposal aimed at ending the war now in its fifth year, but he did not disclose the details of the plan nor specify whether Witkoff and Kushner will go to Ukraine, Russia, or both countries.

According to CNN, a U.S. official said earlier that day that Witkoff and Kushner plan to visit Moscow and Ukraine’s capital Kyiv in the coming days to try to push a diplomatic solution to the conflict.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that the two will fly to Ukraine on Sunday after their visit to Moscow.

Trump said, "We have a peace plan. I sent Witkoff and Kushner, they are both excellent negotiators. They have been doing a great job, and we sent them to see if we can make some progress. And we are very likely to achieve it."
Most of the Trump administration’s attempts to end the Russia‑Ukraine war have yielded little result, and negotiations have stalled in recent months.

At the end of August, CIA Director John Ratcliffe traveled to Moscow, in part to urge the Russian side to consider a peace solution, a trip that Reuters and several other outlets reported at the time.

The majority of Western intelligence officials believe Russian President Vladimir Putin has no intention of reaching an agreement in the short term, while Ukrainian intelligence officials think Putin is more likely to intensify the fighting rather than de‑escalate it.
On Friday, a Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine’s Security Service (SBU) in Kyiv, one of the highest‑profile targets hit since the war began.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 4th), as the U.S. August jobs report far exceeded expectations, prompting traders to raise expectations that the Fed will hike rates later this month, but the dollar still ended the week lower after Thursday’s drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp appreciation of the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.18, down about 0.5% for the week.

Forex market participants focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, August added 162,000 jobs, almost three times the market’s forecast of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
At the same time, the combined non‑farm payroll numbers for June and July were revised upward by 55,000 from previously published figures.

The data were released as the Fed faces a complex policy environment, and markets are watching the direction of interest rates closely. The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – has been above the 2% long‑term target for 65 consecutive months, creating divisions within the FOMC about future monetary policy.

A resilient labour market together with persistently high inflation suggests the economy may be overheating and facing price pressures. In such a scenario, central banks typically consider tightening policy, so traders further bet that the Fed will raise rates later this month.

U.S. President Donald Trump praised the jobs report but paradoxically called for a Fed rate cut and warned that if other countries continue to run trade surpluses with the United States, America will cease trade with those nations.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the August jobs data were released, the market’s probability that the FOMC will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 16 rose from about 52% to roughly 58%.

U.S. government bond selling also heated up, especially in short‑term securities that are most sensitive to upcoming policy tightening. The 2‑year Treasury yield rose 4.5 basis points to 4.379%, while the 10‑year yield climbed 1.8 basis points to 4.780%.
Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers said, “The strong non‑farm payroll data this morning sent yields soaring, but President Trump then rescued U.S. Treasuries.”

He added that the strongest job growth in five months boosted the odds of a rate hike within the next 12 days, pushing the 2‑year yield to a 19‑month high. However, Trump’s comments a few hours after the data release narrowed the Treasury sell‑off, causing yields across maturities to move back toward flat.

Torres noted that while Trump’s remarks threaten the Fed’s independence and are theoretically bearish for the dollar, improving growth prospects are offsetting that negative impact, so the dollar still rose that day, albeit well below its intraday peak.
Yen spikes then retreats
The best‑performing currency this week was the yen, although it weakened on Friday.
The yen surged 1.9% the previous trading day to a one‑month high of ¥155.30 per dollar, sparking widespread speculation that the Japanese government might intervene in the FX market.
Even without official confirmation of intervention, the yen still rose 2.5% this week, marking its strongest weekly performance since the end of July.

The recent yen rally is mainly driven by market bets that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates by 25 basis points at their September 17‑18 meeting and signal that monetary‑policy normalisation will continue through 2027.
Among other currencies, the Canadian dollar weakened, with USD/CAD up 0.3% at 1.3830.

Canada’s government earlier released data showing a sharp slowdown in August’s labour market, with employment falling by 41,700 jobs. The strong hiring surge that characterised early summer has faded, and heightened uncertainty from new U.S. tariffs is adding pressure on firms. The market had expected August employment to rise by 15,000, and the actual figure also reversed the July gain of 75,100 jobs.
The euro rose 0.2% this week as markets await the European Central Bank’s rate decision on September 10. Consensus now points to a 25‑basis‑point hike by the ECB.

items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

items.title: 台灣8月外匯存底重返6000億美元關 終結連2減 增額創16個月來最大
items.title_en: Taiwan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Rebound to $600.19 B, Ending Two‑Month Decline and Marking the Largest Increase in 16 Months
paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 印尼盾有望連續第五周上漲 寫兩年來最長連漲紀錄
items.title_en: Indonesian Rupiah Poised for Fifth Consecutive Week of Gains, Setting Two-Year Longest Winning Streak
paras: 印尼盾近日表現強勁，預計將迎來連續第五周上漲，創下兩年來最長的周度連漲走勢。
印尼盾兌美元匯率在周五(4日)亞市早盤交易中報 17,628，持續徘徊在 17,650 附近，本周美元兌印尼盾預計下跌 0.4%，有望創下自 5 月 20 日以來的最低收盤價格。
此波強勢上漲主要受到內外部因素的雙重支撐。其中，外部環境改善，市場因聯準會(Fed)官員的鴿派言論，調降了本月的升息預期。美債殖利率的回落與美元的走弱，皆為印尼盾提供了顯著的短期支撐。
內部政策也有助維持穩定，印尼央行承諾維護匯率穩定。新任印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti釋放了政策延續性的訊號，強調政策以穩定為先，並透過綜合政策助力經濟成長、維持對境外投資人的吸引力。她也提到，目前國內通膨仍處於受控狀態。
然而，市場分析也指出潛在的制約因素。華僑銀行外匯策略師 Christopher Wong 提醒，高油價與持續高企的全球殖利率依舊是潛在風險。此外，聖嬰現象(El Niño)可能干擾食品供應並推高物價，加上市場在下周公布 8 月外匯存底、消費者信心和 7 月零售銷售等數據前持謹慎態度，皆可能使後續漲勢增添變數。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah has been performing strongly recently and is expected to record a fifth consecutive week of gains, marking the longest weekly rally in two years.

The rupiah’s exchange rate against the US dollar was reported at 17,628 in early Asian market trading on Friday (the 4th), hovering around the 17,650 level. This week the dollar is projected to fall 0.4% against the rupiah, potentially delivering the lowest closing price since May 20.

The robust rise is driven by a dual boost of external and internal factors. Externally, the environment has improved as Fed officials’ dovish remarks have lowered market expectations for rate hikes this month. Falling US Treasury yields and a weaker dollar have provided significant short‑term support for the rupiah.

Domestically, policy measures are helping maintain stability. The Bank of Indonesia has pledged to keep the exchange rate steady. New governor Destry Damayanti signaled policy continuity, emphasizing stability as the priority and using a comprehensive policy mix to support growth and retain foreign investor appeal. She also noted that domestic inflation remains under control.

However, analysts point to potential headwinds. OCBC’s FX strategist Christopher Wong warned that high oil prices and persistently elevated global yields remain risks. Additionally, the El Niño phenomenon could disrupt food supplies and push prices higher, and market participants are cautious ahead of next week’s releases of August foreign‑exchange reserves, consumer confidence and July retail sales data, which could add uncertainty to further gains.

items.title: 野村：極端情境下 日本最快今年底前連三次升息
items.title_en: Nomura: In Extreme Scenarios the BOJ Could Raise Rates Three Times Before Year‑End
paras: 野村證券預測，若日元持續走弱，在最極端的情境下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)可能一路到12月的三次會議上都將接連升息。
野村日本外匯策略主管Yujiro Goto表示，日銀9月升息1碼(25個基點)「看起來合理」，「如果日元走弱的動能持續，朝160日元兌1美元方向發展，那麼10月與12月也可能連續升息」。
他的談話凸顯市場對日銀政策預期所出現的戲劇性轉變。直到不久前，日銀仍以審慎步調推動貨幣政策正常化，如今市場卻開始押注可能加快緊縮腳步。
在市場預期日銀將加速升息，並揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的情況下，日元兌美元本周已升值逾2%，來到約156。
隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場顯示，交易員已幾乎篤定日銀9月會升息1碼，並押注明年1月前還會再升息一次。
日銀總裁植田和男先前曾暗示，日銀可能在即將召開的會議上採取行動。而央行內部立場數一數二鷹派的委員高田創(Hajime Takata) ，也並未排除一次較大幅度升息，以及連續升息的可能性。
日元周四(3日)成為外匯市場焦點，當天兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日歷史性聯手干預匯市短短數日。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160整數關卡，也就是被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
不過，若真的連續三次會議升息，對過去30年大部分時間都在對抗通縮、並將借貸成本維持在接近零水準的日銀而言，將代表極為罕見的快速緊縮步調。
Goto的基本預測情境則沒有如此激進。他預期，日銀未來每季至少升息一次的可能性或必要性很高，目前對日元匯價預測仍維持在154。
Goto表示，日本政府對貨幣政策的態度，可能是決定日元漲勢能否持續的關鍵。投資人正關注日本首相高市早苗是否會釋出支持日本銀行進一步緊縮政策的訊號，因為她過去曾對升息表達保留態度。
Goto說：「如果高市仍對日本銀行升息表達負面態度，市場將感到失望，日元可能再度遭到拋售。」
反之，如果高市早苗避免對貨幣政策表態，或強調日銀的獨立性，Goto認為，日元有機會升破150日元兌1美元。
美國聯準會(Fed)的政策也可能成為另一項催化劑。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，若接下來公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他將傾向在Fed下一次貨幣政策會議上主張維持利率不變。
Goto認為，從近期Fed官員的談話來看，美國可能不急於在9月升息。
交易員目前預期，Fed決策官員9月15-16日開會時升息的機率約為54%，低於華勒發表談話前的約62%。
假如Fed維持利率不變，而日銀釋出鷹派訊號，美元可能重新走弱，日元可能比投資人預期更早升破155。Goto表示，這將進一步支撐日元走強。
paras_en: Nomura Securities forecasts that if the yen continues to weaken, in the most extreme scenario the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could raise rates at all three meetings through December.

Nomura’s head of Japanese FX strategy, Yujiro Goto, said a 25‑basis‑point hike in September "looks reasonable" and that if yen weakness persists toward ¥160 per dollar, hikes in October and December are also possible.

His comments highlight a dramatic shift in market expectations for BOJ policy. Until recently the BOJ was moving cautiously toward monetary‑policy normalisation, but markets are now betting on a faster tightening pace.

With markets expecting the BOJ to accelerate hikes and speculating that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its portfolio, the yen has appreciated more than 2% against the dollar this week to around ¥156.
The overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders are almost certain of a 25‑basis‑point hike in September and are betting on another hike before January next year.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has previously hinted that the central bank may act at the upcoming meeting, and hawkish board member Hajime Takata has not ruled out a larger‑than‑usual hike or consecutive hikes.
The yen was the focus of the FX market on Thursday (the 3rd), briefly reaching ¥155.30 per dollar, the highest since August 3, just days after a historic joint US‑Japan intervention in the market.

Earlier this week the yen slipped past the ¥160 whole‑number barrier, a level the Tokyo authorities closely monitor for possible intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation ran rampant among investors.

If the BOJ were to raise rates at three consecutive meetings, it would represent an unusually rapid tightening for a central bank that has spent most of the past 30 years fighting deflation and keeping borrowing costs near zero.

Goto’s baseline scenario is less aggressive. He expects a high likelihood or even necessity that the BOJ will raise rates at least once each quarter, and he still forecasts the yen around ¥154 per dollar.

Goto said the Japanese government’s stance on monetary policy could be decisive for the yen’s upward momentum, and investors are watching whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will signal support for further BOJ tightening, as she has previously expressed reservations about rate hikes.
"If Takaichi continues to voice a negative view on BOJ rate hikes, the market will be disappointed and the yen could be sold off again," Goto said.
Conversely, if Takaichi avoids commenting on policy or stresses the BOJ’s independence, Goto believes the yen could break above ¥150 per dollar.

U.S. Federal Reserve policy could also act as a catalyst. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that if upcoming data confirm cooling inflation pressures, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged at the next Fed meeting.
Goto thinks recent Fed officials’ remarks suggest the United States is unlikely to rush a September rate hike.
Traders currently estimate about a 54% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, down from roughly 62% before Waller’s comments.

If the Fed holds rates steady while the BOJ signals hawkishness, the dollar could weaken again and the yen might appreciate beyond investors’ expectations, possibly breaking above ¥155, which Goto says would further support yen strength.

items.title: 全球利率預期轉向 亞洲貨幣周五普遍走強
items.title_en: Global rate expectations shift, Asian currencies broadly stronger on Friday
paras: 受到聯準會官員言論影響，全球利率預期有所轉變，帶動亞洲主要貨幣在周五普遍走強。
美國聯邦準備理事會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨持續放緩，他將支持本月維持利率不變。此番言論降溫了市場對9月升息的預期，使美元面臨壓力，美元指數本周預計下跌0.7%至99.06。市場目前正密切關注即將公佈的美國8月份非農就業報告。
在此背景下，日元表現尤受矚目，有望創下自7月底以來最強勁的單周表現，本周已經升值約2.5%。
雖然美元周五兌日元午盤上漲0.3%至156.36，但日元在盤中一度強彈至155.25，逼近7月美日聯合干預時的155.2水位。市場分析指出，日元這波升值並非源於官方直接干預，而是因為市場預期日本央行(BOJ)可能在9月17至18日的會議上採取更鷹派的立場。日本央行此前已在6月將政策利率提高至1%，市場正定價9月再次升息的極高可能性。
與此同時，其他亞太貨幣也各有波動。人民幣匯率保持平穩，受弱勢美元支撐，投資人正持續評估中國私營部門服務業數據與疲軟的官方經濟背景。紐西蘭元與澳元也跟隨央行與貿易訊號波動，美元兌紐元下跌0.3%至1.70左右(紐元約合0.59美元)，紐西蘭央行此前升息25個基點至2.75%；澳洲第二季經濟成長0.4%，澳元兌美元維持在0.72美元附近。
此外，馬來西亞央行周四宣布將基準利率維持在2.75%，美元兌馬來西亞令吉在決議後微幅上漲0.16%至4.04。韓元兌美元小幅升值0.05%，至1,355.65兌1美元，而印度盧比則延續了本周的升勢。
paras_en: Influenced by comments from Federal Reserve officials, global rate expectations have shifted, driving the main Asian currencies to broadly strengthen on Friday.

Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to ease, he would support keeping rates unchanged this month. His remarks cooled expectations of a September rate hike, putting pressure on the dollar, with the dollar index expected to fall 0.7% this week to 99.06. Markets are now closely watching the upcoming U.S. August non‑farm payroll report.
Against this backdrop, the yen is attracting particular attention, poised for its strongest weekly gain since the end of July, having already appreciated about 2.5% this week.

Although the dollar rose 0.3% to 156.36 per yen at midday on Friday, the yen surged intraday to 155.25, nearing the 155.2 level seen during the July US‑Japan joint intervention. Analysts note that this yen rally is not the result of direct official intervention but stems from market expectations that the Bank of Japan may adopt a more hawkish stance at its September 17‑18 meeting. The BOJ had previously lifted its policy rate to 1% in June, and markets are pricing a very high probability of another hike in September.

Meanwhile, other Asia‑Pacific currencies showed varied moves. The renminbi remained stable, supported by a weaker dollar, as investors continue to assess Chinese private‑sector services data and a soft official economic backdrop. The New Zealand dollar and Australian dollar also fluctuated on central‑bank and trade signals, with the dollar down about 0.3% to around 1.70 NZD (≈ 0.59 USD) and the RBNZ having previously raised rates by 25 basis points to 2.75%; Australia’s Q2 growth was 0.4%, keeping the Aussie near 0.72 USD.

In addition, Malaysia’s central bank announced on Thursday that it would keep its benchmark rate at 2.75%, with the dollar edging up 0.16% to 4.04 Malaysian ringgit after the decision. The Korean won modestly appreciated 0.05% to 1,355.65 per dollar, while the Indian rupee continued its upward trend for the week.

items.title: 17兆日元空單緊張！日元升破155恐引爆踩踏 匯率直奔142區間
items.title_en: 17 Trillion Yen Short Positions Tighten as Yen Surpasses 155 Threatens a Crash, Currency Heads Straight to 142 Range
paras: 摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 策略師指出，若日元匯率升破155日元兌1美元的關鍵防線，規模龐大的日元空頭部位進一步回補，可能加速日元漲勢。
Junya Tanase等策略師在研究報告中寫道：「近期價格走勢似乎印證我們的看法，即市場可能仍持有相對龐大的日元空頭部位。」若美元兌日元跌破155，「不能排除賣壓引發更多賣盤，推動日元升幅超出預期的風險。」
摩根大通估計，目前市場尚未平倉的看空日元部位約達16兆至17兆日元（約1,026億美元），若這些部位全面回補，理論上可能將美元兌日元推低至142至146區間。
這項警告發布之際，日元剛經歷自7月底日本與美國聯手干預匯市以來最猛烈的漲勢之一。美元兌日元本周稍早一度升至160.39，創該次干預以來最高，隨後急遽反轉，最低跌至155.30，距離干預後低點155.23僅一步之遙。
這波強勁漲勢主要受到市場揣測日本國家退休金基金（GPIF）可能調整資產配置，以及日本央行將加快升息步伐的預期升溫所帶動。
市場觀察人士指出，投機性日元空單回補與日本國內投資人的避險需求，進一步放大這些利多因素，也提高日元續漲迫使更多空頭部位平倉的風險。
不過，摩根大通認為，市場對GPIF與日本央行的預期「似乎有些過度」，現階段並不認為美元兌日元大幅跌破其預估的155至165區間具有很高機率。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase analysts noted that if the yen breaks the critical 155 yen per dollar barrier, the massive short positions could be further closed, potentially accelerating the yen’s rise.

Junya Tanase and other strategists wrote in a research note that recent price action seems to confirm their view that the market may still hold a relatively large short yen position; if the dollar falls below 155 yen, "selling pressure could trigger more sales, pushing the yen higher than expected."

JPMorgan estimates that the market still has about 16 to 17 trillion yen (roughly $102.6 billion) of short yen positions open; if these are fully closed, the dollar could be pushed into the 142‑146 yen range.

At the time of this warning, the yen had just experienced one of the strongest rallies since the joint intervention by Japan and the United States at the end of July. The dollar‑yen pair briefly touched 160.39 earlier this week, the highest since the intervention, before sharply reversing and falling to a low of 155.30, just one point above the post‑intervention trough of 155.23.

The strong rally was mainly driven by market speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) might adjust its asset allocation, coupled with expectations that the Bank of Japan would accelerate its rate‑hike pace.

Market observers pointed out that speculative short yen positions and domestic Japanese investors’ hedging demand further amplified these positive factors, increasing the risk that the yen’s continued rise would force more shorts to close.

However, JPMorgan believes that expectations around GPIF and the Bank of Japan are "seemingly somewhat over‑stretched," and at present does not see a high probability of the dollar‑yen falling sharply below the 155‑165 range it estimated.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國就業數據前，美元普遍下跌

paras: ◆USD/JPY

據日本財務大臣片山皋月稱，美國財政部長貝森特從未直接要求其採取任何行動，但財務官三村淳表示當局對近期日圓走勢仍不安，繼續隨時準備在外匯市場採取行動，而且市場預期BOJ加快加息步伐，延續日圓漲勢；此外，美國企業8月計畫裁員數為四年來最低及第二季非農業生產環比年率修正增長1.4%未變，而且美國供應管理協會(ISM)調查8月非製造業PMI升至55.4，但美國上周初請失業金人數經季節調整增至20.6萬人，另外S&P全球美國8月綜合PMI終值維持56.0，但服務業PMI終值降至56.5，並據FED理事沃勒認為美國通貨膨脹降溫，傾向利率不變，而且美國7月貿易逆差擴大至886億美元，重創美元兌日圓至155.28低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於156.00-20，支撐於153.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲數據顯示7月商品和服務進口與出口分別較前月降2.5%及3.3%，促使貿易順差縮窄至19億澳幣，但高於預期順差14.5億澳幣，強化澳洲央行(RBA)本月稍晚第四次升息的預期，並據紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)總裁布雷曼稱，燃油價格上漲可能推高核心通貨膨脹率，支撐澳幣和紐元，但日圓急升，令兩者受限，歐元兌美元亦下滑至1.1582低點。

隨後據S&P全球調查8月服務業PMI，法國與歐元區降至48.0及51.6遜於預期，但德國升至49.7，另外德國伊福經濟研究所(Ifo)分別上調德國今年與明年國內生產總值(GDP)增長預期至1.4%及1.2%，並據歐元區公布7月生產者物價指數(PPI)分別較前月與上年同期升1.6%及5.8%超過預估值，而且預計歐洲央行(ECB)於9月第二次加息，推升歐元兌美元至1.1641高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1600-20，阻力於1.1680-1.1700。
◆GBP/USD

居高不下的英國公債收益率，加劇市場擔憂英國財政，而且地緣政治持續動盪，週四打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3476低點，隨後S&P全球公布英國8月服務業PMI終值為52.5，創4月以來最強勁增長及高於7月的52.1，顯示占據主導地位的服務業連續第二個月實現增長，行業信心也有所提升，而且日圓上揚拖累美元和油價趨穩，扶助英鎊兌美元回升至1.3547高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3500-20，阻力於1.3600-20。
